jobs.description:
Contracts Administrator (Legal Operations, CLM & Contract Lifecycle Management) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Contracts Administrator to manage the complete contract lifecycle—from intake and drafting through execution, renewals, compliance tracking, and reporting.

This is a highly detail-oriented, process-driven role responsible for ensuring contracts move efficiently, accurately, and compliantly across Legal, Sales, Procurement, Finance, Security, and Executive teams. You’ll oversee contract workflows, coordinate approvals, maintain CLM systems, track renewals, and support audit readiness while helping build scalable legal operations.

If you thrive in structured, high-volume environments and enjoy creating organized, efficient systems, this role offers excellent ownership and long-term growth.

Responsibilities

Contract Lifecycle Management

  • Manage contracts from intake through drafting, review, approval, execution, storage, renewals, and reporting.
  • Ensure agreements are accurate, compliant, fully executed, searchable, and audit-ready.
  • Maintain contract repositories and ensure complete documentation throughout the contract lifecycle.

Contract Drafting, Review & Redlining

  • Draft, review, and manage agreements including:
    • NDAs
    • DPAs
    • Statements of Work (SOWs)
    • Master Service Agreements (MSAs)
    • Vendor Agreements
    • Order Forms
    • Partner and Reseller Agreements
  • Redline contracts using Microsoft Word Track Changes.
  • Escalate non-standard legal terms involving indemnification, limitation of liability, intellectual property, data privacy, termination clauses, and service level agreements.
  • Maintain deviation logs, approval records, and contract history.

Approvals & Governance

  • Coordinate contract approvals across Legal, Finance, Procurement, Security, Information Security, Sales, and Executive teams.
  • Verify commercial terms align with pricing and business requirements.
  • Ensure vendor onboarding documentation is complete, including:
    • W-9 forms
    • Certificates of Insurance (COIs)
    • Banking information
    • Compliance documentation

Contract Execution & Repository Management

  • Manage electronic signature workflows using DocuSign or Adobe Sign.
  • Verify signer authority, signature blocks, and execution completeness.
  • Maintain agreements within CLM platforms such as Ironclad, Icertis, Agiloft, ContractWorks, Conga, SharePoint, or similar systems.
  • Ensure metadata remains accurate, including contract value, effective dates, renewal terms, jurisdiction, and privacy addenda.

Renewals, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Track contract renewals, notice periods, pricing changes, deliverables, and contractual obligations.
  • Send proactive renewal reminders to internal stakeholders.
  • Support compliance with GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOX, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready documentation and approval records.

Reporting & Process Improvement

  • Prepare reports covering:
    • Contract cycle times
    • SLA performance
    • Renewal pipeline
    • Contract deviations
    • Standard versus non-standard agreements
  • Improve contract templates, clause libraries, approval workflows, and CLM processes.
  • Help scale legal operations through workflow automation and documentation improvements.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Process-driven and comfortable managing high-volume contract workflows.
  • Strong communicator who collaborates effectively across multiple departments.
  • Able to identify contractual risks, inconsistencies, and missing information quickly.
  • Passionate about building efficient, scalable operational systems.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in Contracts Administration, Legal Operations, or Contract Coordination.
  • Hands-on experience with CLM platforms such as Ironclad, Icertis, Agiloft, ContractWorks, Conga, SharePoint, or similar systems.
  • Strong proficiency with:
    • Microsoft Word Track Changes
    • Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets
    • PDF editing software
  • Working knowledge of:
    • NDAs
    • DPAs
    • MSAs
    • Confidentiality agreements
    • Indemnification
    • Intellectual property clauses
    • Limitation of liability
    • Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOX, or other regulated environments.
  • Experience with both buy-side and sell-side contracts.
  • Exposure to procurement, vendor onboarding, vendor risk management, or security questionnaires.
  • Experience developing clause libraries, contract templates, and legal playbooks.

What Success Looks Like

  • Contract cycle times consistently meet SLA targets.
  • Zero missed renewals, notice periods, or contractual obligations.
  • Accurate and complete contract repository with 100% metadata accuracy.
  • High percentage of agreements executed using approved standard language.
  • Audit-ready documentation maintained at all times.
  • Continuous improvements in legal operations through process optimization.

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen
  • Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  • Practical Assessment (NDA Redlining & Contract Tracking Exercise)
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This allows hiring managers to assess your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

We’re focused on helping people with diabetes manage their health with life-changing products that provide accurate data to drive better-informed decisions. We’re revolutionizing the way people monitor their glucose levels with our new sensing technology.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year

  • An excellent retirement savings plan with high employer contribution

  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.

  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This Staff Cybersecurity Engineer position can work out remotely within the U.S.

The Staff Cybersecurity Engineer leads strategic cybersecurity initiatives that identify, prioritize, and resolve product security risks, vulnerabilities, and threats. This role drives mitigation and remediation strategies across complex, cross-functional product environments to ensure Abbott builds safe and secure products that comply with industry cybersecurity regulations and meet customer and patient security expectations.

What You’ll Work On

  • Drive strategic AI-enabled cybersecurity workflows through custom models, skills, and agentic development to reduce vulnerability risk, mature repeatable processes, and scale security decision support.

  • Lead product cybersecurity release readiness by delivering SBOMs, vulnerability remediation evidence, and release security documentation. Drive technical reviews with development teams to resolve vulnerabilities, validate controls, manage remediation progress, and communicate residual risk.

  • Lead vulnerability remediation and patch prioritization based on business impact, proof of exploit, regulatory expectations, and policy requirements, partnering with engineering, PMs, and product owners to drive timely risk reduction.

  • Architect systematic remediation strategies and preventive controls that reduce recurring vulnerabilities, including secure coding practices, dependency management, configuration hardening, and scalable governance across product and supporting applications.

  • Lead complex and ambiguous security problems to resolution by decomposing risk, aligning stakeholders on technical direction, removing blockers, and driving durable outcomes across large product and platform efforts.

  • Validate security fixes through hands-on testing, with depth in one or more product security domains such as web application testing using Burp Suite and Postman, hardware testing, or verification of iOS and Android mobile application vulnerability remediation.

  • Clearly communicate complex technical security concepts to executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, translating vulnerability findings, security controls, and security metrics into business-relevant risk insights and decision support.

  • Lead remediation efforts after security assessments identify weaknesses requiring attention. Drive advancement of the cyber threat and vulnerability management program to ensure consistent identification, analysis, response, monitoring, and resolution of cybersecurity threats, events, and vulnerabilities.

  • Leverage JIRA for security project and vulnerability management, building dashboards, reports, and automation workflows that improve remediation visibility, surface strategic metrics, and drive accountability across cross-functional teams.

  • Lead triage of findings from application, network-based, and agent-based security scanning tools (SAST, DAST, SCA, infrastructure scanners) to determine true security impact, validate exploitability, distinguish false positives, and communicate residual risk and remediation activities to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Drive cross-functional execution of security goals and detailed implementation plans for security projects. Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and training on potential security risks, prevention strategies, and practical remediation approaches.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Security Systems, or related fields.

  • Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 5 years of experience in IT management system, cybersecurity, or other relevant experience with a strong preference for product security, including consumer-facing applications and services.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience leading web, mobile, cloud infrastructure, and product security testing using DAST, SAST, SCA, SBOM generation tooling, and network- and agent-based vulnerability scanning tools.

  • Ability to lead multiple complex cybersecurity initiatives with strong organization skills.

  • Demonstrated critical thinking, analytical skills, judgment, and logic for resolving large, ambiguous problems in an environment with changing priorities.

  • Ability to lead effectively in cross-functional team environments, adapting to rapidly changing business and technological needs while driving stakeholders toward clear decisions and outcomes.

  • Excellent executive-facing documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Holds or is actively pursuing one or more industry-recognized cybersecurity certifications, such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, or equivalent.

  • Previous work experience in a product development cybersecurity role.

  • Familiarity with design of diagnostic equipment, medical devices, or other closely related products.

jobs.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

Grüns is growing fast and we need people who think clearly, move quickly, and help us stay ahead of the curve as we scale. This is a role for someone who wants to be in the room where it happens — not just supporting the work, but driving it. As a BizOps Associate, you'll be the analytical engine behind some of our biggest growth bets — embedded inside the business, not above it. You'll own problems end-to-end, from framing the question to driving the answer into action. This role reports directly to our Director of BizOps and sits at the center of how Grüns makes decisions.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Identify high-impact business challenges and opportunities, structure them as problems worth solving, and drive analysis that leads to a clear recommendation — not just a report
  • Build and own financial models that forecast the impact of new strategies, pricing decisions, and growth initiatives, and hold yourself accountable to measuring actual performance against those forecasts
  • Partner directly with senior leaders across retail, DTC, marketing, and operations to answer their hardest questions — and proactively surface the questions they haven't thought to ask yet
  • Design and run tests: develop hypotheses, build the analytical framework, execute, and translate results into decisions the business can act on
  • Own ad hoc analysis and KPI reporting for key stakeholders — building infrastructure that becomes a lasting resource, not a one-time deliverable
  • Support new product and pricing strategy with modeling and market analysis
  • Evaluate new growth channels and optimize existing ones across our DTC and retail business

We're looking for someone who has:

  • BS/MS Degree in a quantitative or computational field
  • 4+ years experience in data analytics in corporate, consulting, or investment banking
  • Exceptional communication skills with technical and non-technical audiences, able to influence your partners using clear, concise insights and recommendations through strong data-driven analyses
  • High proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides
  • Expertise with SQL, with R and/or Python knowledge preferred
  • Exceptional thought partnership skills, able to own direct relationships with stakeholders and build credibility through clarity and judgment
  • Strong statistical skills and intuition for solving problems in both consumer-facing and internal product areas
  • Experience with Cloud Computing (Google Cloud) platforms preferred

Approach to the role:

  • You don't wait to be handed a problem — you go find it, frame it, and bring back a recommendation
  • You move between deep analytical work and senior stakeholder conversations without missing a beat.
  • You thrive in ambiguity and resource-light environments — "we don't have a process for that yet" sounds like opportunity, not friction
  • You hold yourself to a high standard of intellectual honesty — you'd rather deliver an uncomfortable truth than a comfortable slide
  • You move fast without cutting corners on rigor, and you understand that speed and quality aren't opposites
  • You're energized by working on a product you believe in and a team that holds itself to a high bar

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $120,000-$135,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

🏹 Perfil del Archer

Buscamos un/a Analista de fondos y programas de financiamiento con fuerte capacidad analítica, orientación al detalle y experiencia gestionando programas de financiamiento de fabricantes tecnológicos, idealmente AWS.

Valoramos profesionales organizados, autónomos y rigurosos, capaces de coordinar múltiples iniciativas de manera simultánea, administrar fondos eficientemente y mantener una comunicación efectiva con áreas comerciales, operativas y partners estratégicos. Buscamos una persona con interés por el análisis financiero, el control de procesos y la optimización continua, que disfrute trabajar con seguimiento, planificación y cumplimiento de objetivos.

🎯 Objetivo del rol

Gestionar y optimizar integralmente los programas de financiamiento de AWS y otros fabricantes tecnológicos, asegurando la correcta aplicación, ejecución, recuperación y control de fondos. El rol tiene como propósito maximizar el aprovechamiento de las oportunidades de funding, garantizando visibilidad, cumplimiento y alineación con la estrategia comercial y de crecimiento de ARKHO.

🚀 Principales desafíos

  • Identificar oportunidades de funding para iniciativas comerciales, preventa, marketing y habilitación técnica.

  • Gestionar postulaciones, aprobaciones, ejecución, recuperación y cierre de fondos.

  • Mantener actualizada la información de programas, requisitos, vigencias y oportunidades.

  • Monitorear fondos, hitos, vencimientos y procesos asociados.

  • Elaborar reportes y dashboards para asegurar visibilidad y control de la gestión.

  • Garantizar el cumplimiento de políticas y requisitos definidos por los fabricantes.

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Loan Coordinator / Lender Liaison to ensure loan files move efficiently from submission through closing.

Lender Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact with lending partners.
  • Maintain regular communication throughout the loan lifecycle.
  • Follow up on outstanding lender requests and documentation.
  • Escalate issues proactively to prevent funding or closing delays.

Loan Pipeline Management

  • Monitor active loan files from submission through closing.
  • Maintain accurate loan status updates and progress tracking.
  • Review loan reports and identify delays or missing documentation.
  • Keep stakeholders informed of loan progress and next steps.

Internal Coordination

  • Work with internal teams to gather required documentation.
  • Coordinate responses to underwriting conditions and lender requests.
  • Support timely submission of loan packages.
  • Ensure deadlines and timelines remain on track.

Documentation & File Management

  • Organize and maintain complete loan files.
  • Record correspondence and supporting documentation.
  • Maintain accurate CRM and loan management system records.
  • Verify file completeness before key milestones and closing.

Process Improvement

  • Identify workflow inefficiencies.
  • Recommend improvements to loan coordination processes.
  • Support standardized procedures for lender communication and pipeline management.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience in loan coordination, loan processing, mortgage operations, lender relations, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of the mortgage and lending process.
  • Experience managing loan files from submission through closing.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and project management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple active loan files simultaneously.
  • Experience using CRM systems and Google Workspace.
  • High attention to detail and deadline management skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Reliable internet connection and availability for 30+ hours per week.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with DSCR, investment-property, or non-QM loans.
  • Experience supporting real estate investors.
  • Familiarity with Encompass, LendingPad, Jungo, Salesforce, or similar loan platforms.
  • Background in real estate operations or acquisitions.
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based mortgage lenders or brokers.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review active loan files and lender updates.
  • Follow up on outstanding conditions and documentation.
  • Coordinate with lenders, underwriters, and internal teams.
  • Update loan statuses and CRM records.
  • Track deadlines and resolve bottlenecks.
  • Ensure loan files are complete before closing.

In short: You’ll keep loan files organized, lenders informed, and closings on schedule from submission through funding.

What Success Looks Like

  • Loan files progress smoothly through the pipeline.
  • Deadlines and closing timelines are consistently met.
  • Accurate and organized loan documentation.
  • Strong communication with lenders and internal teams.
  • Reduced processing delays and bottlenecks.
  • High stakeholder satisfaction.

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your mortgage operations experience, and highlight your background in loan coordination, lender communication, documentation management, and pipeline tracking. Your video will be reviewed before moving forward in the interview process.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you enjoy keeping loan files organized, coordinating with lenders, managing deadlines, and ensuring smooth loan closings, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help deliver an exceptional lending experience.

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applicants living in UK time zones only at this time.

Software Engineer - Platform Productivity

The Opportunity:

Grafana Cloud moves millions of metrics, log lines, and traces per second from our customers' environments into a highly available, low-latency stack that processes and stores these data, and serves them to dashboards and alerting tools. We aim to grow this to hundreds of millions per second, and it's critical that as we grow, we improve our performance, increase our reliability, and, of course, do it efficiently and effectively.

The Internal Engineering Platform delivered by the Platform department provides application engineers with the tools, systems and Kubernetes clusters they need to build, deploy and run their workloads. Platform roles at Grafana Labs have an eye for engineers with a passion for performance and reliability, and who enjoy taking projects from conception to production. We organize ourselves into squads to allow focus on Cloud Infrastructure, Networking and Security; engineering Productivity; Capacity management, Client Administrative Tooling (CAT); and US Federal compliance.

Because we deploy production services, we have on-call rotations to ensure the health of the system. Everyone at Grafana Labs tries to incorporate and use our product line up into their day-to-day, so being on call is an important way to understand our system and how people use our products.

What You’ll Be Doing:

We are hiring for the Platform Productivity squad. The squad is mostly responsible for helping our internal engineers release their software onto our infrastructure, in secure and measurable ways. They lead automation of the release processes (anywhere from CI/CD to bootstrapping) and help our internal engineering teams get on board with them using ‘golden path’ techniques, but also helping edge cases and making sure that teams can get the most out of our tools.

At the end of the day, we’re the Platform Team for the teams that are building some of the most cherished observability tools– from Grafana, Mimir and Loki, to Tempo.

The squad is responsible for setting its own roadmap, and as a part of the team you'll have a part to play in that process. You'll help us maintain, improve and extend what we already have. You'll be involved in choosing what we focus on next and, just as importantly, when and how to gracefully sunset systems which are no longer needed. Your responsibilities will also include helping the team to design, compare, and choose appropriate solutions for (at least some) of the following things:

  • Development and maintenance of our Internal Engineering Platform (IEP)
  • CI/CD platform management and development
  • Build, release and deployment automation
  • Application configuration management tooling
  • “Up to date” software automation
  • Artefact management
  • Working with diverse internal teams, from application development to security, to support implementation of their requirements
  • Being part of an on-call rotation to support Platform tooling

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

Of course, there is an on-call component to this role and one that we take seriously. As a company, we hire globally (remote-first) to ensure our on-call remains healthy and aligned to approximately 12 daylight hours per day. You will work closely with counterparts in other regions to provide balanced coverage and shared ownership.

A few of our upcoming projects:

  • Development of our next gen CI/CD systems
  • Automation runner infrastructure, security and management
  • Artefact management systems
  • Development of security automation as part of our CI/CD systems
  • Development of AI-backed tooling to improve support of our internal users

What Makes You a Great Fit:

You enjoy working with engineers, as well as with the management structures that are there to support you and enable you and your team to do your very best.

You are comfortable working in a remote-first company; communication is key. For us, working together means being collaborative, friendly, kind, and respectful. We operate by consensus, you can contribute to a discussion but then commit to the team decision.

You are eager to learn and grow. There is a lot of room for growth and development, and the team has quite a lot of knowledge to share for those who are wanting to learn.

You approach development holistically. The team owns the full life cycle of our code; from writing design docs, looking at developer feedback, testing and deployment, all the way through to decommissioning. We appreciate engineers who enjoy looking at the big picture, and also notice the details of the brush strokes. You're a flexible software engineer. In a typical day, we might spend time responding to incidents, integrating existing systems, or designing and implementing our own systems. While our primary language is Go, we value flexibility and we'll choose the best tool for the job, even if that is a shell script.

You have experience with operating your code. Since a lot of operators and developers use our software, having some grounding in both of these spaces really helps us with building better platforms for our users. Kubernetes and Docker are what we use, mostly. We also work with a lot of Infrastructure as Code, so be sure to check out grafana/tanka.

jobs.description:
Looking to work with cutting-edge engineering software? What if you could work with all of them?

WHAT YOU WILL DO

At Synera, we build an agentic automation platform for engineers that helps them create better products faster. Our software connects engineering tools, data, and people, enabling teams to automate complex workflows and focus on what really matters: solving hard engineering problems. We already have 80+ software integrations, ranging from the biggest players to the latest startups, and we're just getting started.

We're looking for an Integration Developer who truly understands engineering and who uses AI as a natural part of how they work, not an afterthought.

This role sits at the intersection of software development, partner collaboration, and engineering system implementation: you'll own the development of add-ins and integrations within our agentic platform, be the first dedicated technical member of our new Marketplace team, and work closely with Andrew, our VP of Software Partnerships, who leads the marketplace roadmap and relations with over 25+ different software partners. You'll work with a wide range of technologies – CAD tools, simulation solvers, PLM systems, and AI – and you'll have the autonomy to make technical decisions and own integration projects with 3rd parties from end to end.

👉 What a week at Synera could look like:

  • Monday: You join the weekly all-hands to align on company updates, followed by the developer meeting to share progress, questions, and technical insights.

  • Tuesday: After the morning stand-up, you dive into a partner call to help their developers plan their integration with Synera and ensure they build a solid foundation.

  • Wednesday (biweekly): You do backlog refinement and team retrospective to clarify tasks, estimate effort, and improve workflow. In the afternoon, you will work on AI skills to help you speed up the development of integrations by you and our partners.

  • Thursday (biweekly): Sprint review day - you demo the past two weeks' progress on the latest add-in to the internal team and get feedback on some improvements to make. Afterwards, sprint planning defines the next sprint's scope and clarifies any remaining questions.

  • Friday: Andrew invites you to join a customer call, for you to understand more deeply the customer’s PLM environment to help improve one of our existing integrations. In the afternoon, you use your unlimited Claude budget to experiment with anew AI workflow.

The rest of the week’s time is protected focus time: writing code, reviewing Bitbucket pull requests and pushing real value to production.

⚡ In 6 months:

  • You deliver customer-facing value regularly through integration projects.

⚡ In 12 months:

  • You have a growing ownership of complex integrations, especially in the PLM space, you mentor peers, and contribute to architecture and product decisions.

Here is our team at the summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned annual salary ranges are:

  • Experienced Level: 67,000 - 85,000 EUR

  • Advanced Level: 80,500 - 109,000 EUR

We determine the level we hire for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you’ll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • With the high level of ownership, you make a real impact on our Synera software.

  • Flexible working: you decide when & where to work (as long as you have a residency in Germany).

  • Flexible public holidays: swap days off according to your values and beliefs!

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • We don't count your vacation days, as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

  • To support your personal and professional well-being, we offer company fitness with Wellpass and mental health platform nilo.

  • Regular team events, virtual coffee breaks, and spontaneous afterworks. We also get together as a whole company for 2-3 day off-sites twice a year! 🌈

Requirements

🚀 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • You have a deep understanding of developing add-ins, plugins or integrations for complex software systems.

  • You’ve got the AI-native mindset and curiosity to constantly learn and develop your skills in this area.

  • You bring hands-on experience with PLM, SPDM, or MES platforms.

  • You bring strong proficiency in C# and C++, with solid algorithmic and logical thinking skills.

  • You're comfortable working with a high degree of autonomy – communicating directly with partners, making technical decisions, and owning projects from start to finish.

  • You are a strong communicator in English with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day, and be prepared to share with us how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our Marketplace team.

jobs.description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About The Team

The Customer Success organization is composed of three teams: pre-sales, customer success, and support. The Pre-Sales Consultant will join a team of trusted partners to our Account Executives, working closely with prospective clients through new business sales cycles to demonstrate the value of our platform and help drive new revenue. They are problem-solvers, storytellers, and product experts who thrive on helping customers make better and faster decisions.

Pre-Sales Consultants combine deep product knowledge, commercial acumen, industry experience, and strong client intuition to run high-impact evaluations. This role is specific to the Corporate vertical, engaging with decision-makers and users to uncover use cases, run tailored demos and evaluations, whilst guiding prospects to successful outcomes. Due to its extensive client exposure, this role is uniquely positioned to partner with cross-functional teams across Product, Content, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Customer Education to inform go-to-market strategy and decisions.

About The Role & What You’ll Do:

As a Pre-Sales Consultant focused on supporting Corporate professionals with their platform workflows, you will work as part of the sales cycle to bridge the capabilities of our technology with the domain-specific needs and workflows of our clients. You will not only drive value to our clients but also champion their perspective and play a critical role in defining future use cases in AlphaSense for key personas, including:

  • Personas: Strategy, Competitive Intelligence, Corporate Development, Investor Relations

  • Industries: Technology, Media & Telecommunications (TMT); Healthcare & Life Sciences; Energy & Industrials (E Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG); Consulting; Professional Services

What You Will Do:

  • Partner with GTM Teams to Drive Commercial Outcomes: Collaborate closely with Account Executives to take ownership of and run seamless product evaluations in order to drive new business revenue growth.

  • Build and Curate Corporate Use Cases: Conduct targeted discovery into clients' unique research workflows and pain points in order to help them effectively leverage AlphaSense for their bespoke use cases. Continue to seek out and develop new and emerging use cases with clients as AlphaSense’s capabilities evolve.

  • Forge and Maintain Strong Client Relationships: Engage directly with corporate professionals of all levels/seniority to understand their most pressing challenges. Build strong rapport with prospects and establish yourself as a credible domain and product expert who is capable of partnering with them and driving value from evaluation inception through to close.

  • Contribute to Product Development: Translate client feedback and proactively share product & content improvements/enhancement requests internally.

Who You Are:

You have a proven track record of working with corporate professionals to solve complex problems and are passionate about the application of AI to the industry. You are a systems thinker with an ambition to continuously improve processes and a desire to contribute to a fast-growing, entrepreneurial team culture.

What You Bring:

  • Corporate Expertise: 2+ years’ experience in a corporate role, or directly supporting corporate clients in a fintech/SaaS organization, with exposure to workflows in at least one of: Strategy, Competitive Intelligence, Corporate Development, or Investor Relations.

  • Curiosity About Generative AI: A demonstrated interest in the transformative potential of AI for the corporate sector, flexible problem-solving skills, and knowledge of the competitive landscape for GenAI in corporate workflows.

  • Executive Presence & Strong Presentation Skills: A proven capacity to engage stakeholders at all levels, earn their trust, and explain technical solutions to business-oriented audiences. Comfort with conducting evaluations of varying lengths/forms e.g., on-site workshops, whiteboard sessions, multi-call demos etc.

  • High-Impact, Ownership Mindset: An exceptional ability to thrive on autonomy, tackle client questions and challenges with enthusiasm, and drive workflow transformation at some of the world's biggest companies.

  • Consultative Approach: A highly articulate, consultative, and confident client-facing professional with the ability to distill and explain complex issues in simple terms.

  • Team Player: Superior ability to build and maintain strong internal relationships, combined with a positive and proactive personality.

  • Collaboration & Influence: Ability to work cross-functionally and effectively distill client feedback to GTM, Product, and Content teams, in order to continually help influence and improve our capabilities/product offerings.

Candidate Requirements:

  • Minimum 2 years of work experience in a high growth fintech/SaaS firm in one of sales, client success, product, or a related client-facing or research role within the Corporates industry.

  • High aptitude and willingness to learn.

  • Outstanding oral, written, and presentation skills.

  • Effective attention to detail, time management, and task prioritization, even when under pressure.

  • Ability and interest to work autonomously and contribute to a dynamic and entrepreneurial team culture.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and performance incentives.

  • Comprehensive health coverage

  • The chance to join a collaborative, high-energy team making a measurable impact for some of the world’s most influential companies.

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

Base Compensation Range
$80,000—$95,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @ email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

Description

Company Overview

CapsLock is a dynamic marketing company providing IT-enabled solutions for large North American partners. We specialize in scalable customer acquisition through data-driven marketing, creative production, and technology innovation.

Our teams collaborate across Marketing, IT, Analytics, CRO, and Media Buying to build, test, and optimize high-performing funnels that help clients achieve predictable growth across industries such as Home Improvement, Health, Legal, and Insurance.

Role Overview

We're looking for a Senior Marketing Strategist who thinks like a strategist, creative person and optimizer—someone who understands customer behavior, identifies growth opportunities, and continuously improves marketing performance through experimentation.

You'll be responsible for developing new funnels, conducting market and competitor research, generating hypotheses, managing A/B testing initiatives, and collaborating closely with Creative, Media Buying, Analytics, and IT teams to deliver measurable business results.

Success in this role means constantly asking "How can we improve conversion?" and using data to find the answer.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct market, audience, and competitor research for new and existing clients.
  • Develop new landing page concepts and marketing funnels.
  • Generate, prioritize, and document CRO hypotheses.
  • Plan and manage A/B testing roadmaps across multiple clients.
  • Analyze landing page performance and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Copywriters, Designers, Video Producers, IT, and Media Buyers throughout the production process.
  • Review campaign performance and translate data into actionable insights.
  • Identify winning strategies and scale them across similar clients and industries.
  • Maintain and expand the company's CRO knowledge base and testing library.
  • Research new marketing trends, technologies, and customer acquisition strategies.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time and meet quality standards.
  • Present recommendations and optimization plans to internal stakeholders.

AI & Experimentation Mindset

You actively use AI to improve research, productivity, and decision-making. Whether it's generating hypotheses, analyzing competitors, organizing knowledge, or accelerating content creation, you view AI as a strategic assistant rather than a replacement for marketing thinking.

We're looking for someone who enjoys experimenting, learning, and continuously improving existing processes.

Requirements

Essential

  • 5+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, CRO, Digital Marketing, or Growth Marketing.
  • Strong understanding of customer acquisition funnels and landing page optimization.
  • Experience planning and evaluating A/B tests.
  • Ability to interpret marketing data and make data-driven decisions.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills.
  • Exceptional communication skills.
  • Proficient English language skills.
  • Experience with AI tools for marketing research and automation.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in Home Improvement or Lead Generation industries.
  • Experience working with Meta, Google Ads, Native Advertising, or YouTube.
  • Knowledge of UX principles and conversion optimization.
  • Familiarity with Tableau, GA4, Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar, or similar analytics tools.

﻿Why do we deserve your attention?

Not only do we offer fair and competitive pay, but we also provide perks and benefits that support your well-being and growth. Here are some of them:

Remote Work

We are a truly remote-first company. You choose where you feel the most productive and comfortable to make an impact.

Paid Time Off

Work-life balance matters to us, and we support it with paid time off for rest, personal time, or simply doing what makes you happy.

Ongoing Learning

We believe in curiosity and growth. That’s why we support continuous learning with workshops, online courses, conferences, and certifications.

Home Office

We help you set up your perfect workspace by covering equipment and furniture expenses, so you can do your best work from home.

Physical Well-Being

From gym memberships and yoga classes to home workout equipment or even a bicycle, we give you the flexibility to stay active your way.

Unlimited Sick Days

Your health matters. Take the time you need to rest and recover - we’ll be here when you’re ready to return.

Medical Coverage

We support you and your family with reimbursement for medical insurance and health-related expenses, including dental care and psychological support.

Co-Working Space

If you sometimes crave a change of scenery or more social interaction, we’ll cover the full cost of a co-working space.

Fun Stuff

From gaming nights and fitness challenges to annual retreats at world-class resorts, we make sure there’s never a shortage of fun and connection.

This is a remote position.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Oracle APEX Developer to lead the modernization of our legacy systems. In this role, you will be primarily responsible for migrating our existing Oracle Forms 10g applications into modern, responsive Oracle APEX screens. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Oracle database technologies (SQL, PL/SQL) and a strong eye for user interface design, with the ability to conceptualize and build complex UI features from scratch.

Key Responsibilities

  • Legacy Migration: Lead the end-to-end migration of existing Oracle Forms 10g screens and business logic to Oracle APEX.

  • UI/UX & Wireframing: Design and build wireframes to map legacy interfaces to modern web standards. Develop complex, user-friendly UI features within the APEX environment.

  • Database Development: Write, tune, and optimize complex SQL queries and PL/SQL code (packages, procedures, functions, and triggers) to support the new APEX applications.

  • System Integration & Testing: Ensure seamless integration between the database backend and the APEX frontend, maintaining data integrity and system performance.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with business analysts and stakeholders to understand legacy workflows and ensure the new applications meet current business requirements.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Oracle APEX: Proven hands-on experience developing applications using Oracle APEX (Application Express).

  • Oracle Forms: Direct experience with Oracle Forms 10g and a strong understanding of how to transition legacy forms logic to web-based frameworks.

  • Database Expertise: Expert-level proficiency in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.

  • UI/UX Design: Demonstrated ability to create wireframes, mockups, and complex UI designs.

  • Web Technologies: Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to customize and enhance APEX interfaces beyond standard templates.

  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills with the ability to reverse-engineer legacy code and translate it into optimized, modern solutions.

jobs.excerpt: An established global specialty-chemicals manufacturer is seeking an experienced Sales Manager to develop its European business within the coatings and adhesives market.
jobs.description:
An established global specialty-chemicals manufacturer is seeking an experienced Sales Manager to develop its European business within the coatings and adhesives market.

The position will take commercial responsibility for a specialised portfolio of high-molecular-weight saturated polyester resins used as binders and raw materials across industrial coatings, adhesives, inks and related formulation markets.

This is a hands-on commercial role requiring an experienced specialty-chemicals professional who can independently manage key customers, identify new applications and develop business in technically demanding markets. The successful candidate will work closely with customers, distributors and internal technical teams throughout the product-selection, testing, qualification and commercialisation process.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and grow sales across the assigned European territory.
  • Develop relationships with coatings, adhesives and other specialty-chemical formulators.
  • Identify new customers, applications and market-development opportunities.
  • Manage key accounts, pricing, negotiations, forecasting and sales pipelines.
  • Support customers during product evaluation, formulation trials and technical qualification.
  • Work closely with technical, R&D, supply-chain and international commercial teams.
  • Monitor competitor activity, regulatory developments and changing customer requirements.
  • Develop commercial strategies for relevant applications, including coil and can coatings, industrial adhesives, inks, flexible packaging, water-based systems and hot-melt products.
  • Represent the business at customer meetings, industry events and technical exhibitions.
  • Provide regular market intelligence, forecasts and commercial reporting.

Requirements

  • At least 10 years of relevant B2B sales experience within coatings, adhesives or closely related CASE markets.
  • Strong commercial experience in specialty chemicals, polymers, resins, binders or formulation raw materials.
  • Established experience selling to coatings or adhesive manufacturers and formulators.
  • Proven success in key-account management, new-business development, pricing and commercial negotiation.
  • Sufficient technical understanding to discuss resin performance, customer formulations, application testing and product qualification.
  • Direct experience with saturated polyester resins, copolyesters, polyester polyols or comparable coating and adhesive resin portfolios would be highly advantageous.
  • Experience with products used in industrial coatings, coil or can coatings, inks, flexible packaging, polyurethane adhesives or hot-melt applications would be valuable.
  • Able to work independently within an international organisation and manage customers without close supervision.
  • Strong communication, presentation and relationship-management skills.
  • Willingness to travel regularly across Europe.

Academic qualifications in chemistry, polymer science, materials science or a related discipline would be beneficial, although relevant industry knowledge and a strong commercial track record are more important.

Benefits

  • Fully remote role within Europe.
  • High-autonomy commercial position with ownership of key European customer and distributor relationships.
  • Base salary expected in the range of €120,000 - €145,000, depending on experience.
  • Performance-based bonus potential of up to 25% of annual base salary.
  • 30 days of paid leave.
  • Regular exposure to international customers, distributors, technical teams, and global headquarters.
  • Opportunity to support growth in specialist polymer applications, including packaging, cosmetics, consumer goods, industrial, and medical-related markets.
  • Potential to grow into broader European commercial leadership responsibility as the business expands.

About Waymark

Waymark is a team of healthcare providers, technologists, and builders whose mission is to bring the best healthcare to people with Medicaid benefits. Guided by the communities we serve, we bring support and technology-enabled care to help primary care providers keep Medicaid patients healthy. We are building the tools and designing an approach to enable care to reach the patients who can benefit most.

Our core values embody the essence of what makes Waymark a unique team today, and what we look for, nurture, and sustain as a team.

  • We are bold builders, believing that the greatest challenges in care delivery can be solved when we harness the power of community and technology.
  • We are humble learners, seeking feedback and perspectives different from our own, and welcome challenges to our conclusions.
  • We experiment to improve, actively seeking data to inform decisions and to assess our own performance.
  • We act with focused urgency, our commitment to our mission drives us to tirelessly pursue results.

If this vision resonates with you, we hope you consider bringing your creativity, your energy, your curiosity to Waymark.

About this Role

The Director of Implementation serves as the senior operational leader responsible for the end-to-end planning and delivery of Waymark implementations including new geographies, managed care organization (MCO) contract launches, and provider group contract launches. Reporting to the Head of Operations, this leader is accountable for the implementation function, ensuring implementations are delivered on time, in scope, and to a consistently high standard through direct contribution and team management.

This is a hands-on program leadership role for a seasoned project management professional. You will own, build, and run the implementation function's core infrastructure — project plans, workplans, governance structures, status reporting, risk and issue management, and repeatable playbooks — while personally leading the most complex, high-stakes launches. You and your team will be the connective tissue between Waymark's internal teams (clinical, product, engineering, analytics, quality, compliance, and regional market leadership) and our external partners (MCOs, provider groups), managing stakeholders at every level from working teams to executives. This role is a unique opportunity to build and scale the implementation function from the ground up, allowing you to define the strategic and operational roadmap and evolve the team as Waymark grows.

Key Responsibilities

jobs.excerpt: Most AI teams talk about evaluation.  At Synera, you'd own it — end-to-end, in production, for two real agentic products used by companies like BMW, Airbus, and NASA.
jobs.description:
Most AI teams talk about evaluation. At Synera, you'd own it — end-to-end, in production, for two real agentic products used by companies like BMW, Airbus, and NASA.


WHAT YOU WILL DO

You’ll join the Agentic Ants team as our second native AI engineer. You’ll build and extend our agentic systems alongside the rest of the team — new tools, sub-agents, prompt iterations — and co-own the evaluation framework that gates every change: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge pipelines, regression suites, production-trace mining. This isn’t about adding scores to a notebook — it’s about shipping agents the team can trust, and proving it.

You’ll work across both Synera MAS and Synera Assistant, picking up reliability concerns (error handling, retries) as they show up in your work. Partnering with Ruben and the wider engineering team, you’ll also help the team go deeper on customer insights data.

👉 What a week at Synera could look like:

  • Monday: Kick off sprint planning with the Agentic Ants team, review Langfuse traces from the weekend, and flag any new failure modes worth triaging.

  • Tuesday: Work on the golden dataset for the supervisor routing surface — curating examples, versioning the set, and writing evaluators with Ahmed.

  • Wednesday: Join a cross-team sync with QA and product to align on new eval coverage for an upcoming agent feature, then push a CI integration so eval regressions block the next PR.

  • Thursday: Pair with the AI and software engineers on extending our agentic system — a new tool, a routing tweak, or a prompt iteration — then write the eval that gates the change before it ships.

  • Friday: Review a calibrated LLM-as-judge output alongside human labels, refine the rubric, and share findings in the eng review.

⚡ In 6 months:

  • The evaluation framework is live with golden datasets across multiple agent surfaces, CI gates are blocking on regressions, and the team actually trusts the results.

  • You’ve shipped multiple meaningful changes to the agent graphs — new tools, sub-agents, or routing improvements — that are measurably better in production.

⚡ In 12 months:

  • Online evaluation is a habit — production traces feed continuously back into datasets, and the improvement loop is running without manual intervention.

  • You co-own at least one agent surface with the team and have become the go-to person for evaluation methodology at Synera. The combination has measurably improved product quality.

Here is our team at the summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary ranges are:

  • Experienced Level: 77,000 - 97,000 EUR annually

We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • Flexible working: you decide when & where to work (as long as you have a residency in Germany).

  • Flexible public holidays: swap days off according to your values and beliefs!

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • We don't count your vacation days, as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

  • To support your personal and professional well-being, we offer company fitness with Wellpass and mental health platform nilo.

  • Regular team events, virtual coffee breaks, and spontaneous afterworks. We also get together as a whole company for 2-3 day off-sites twice a year! 🌈

Requirements

🚀 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • You’ve designed and shipped agent graphs in production with LangGraph or equivalent — supervisor / sub-agent patterns, tool design, prompt iteration.

  • You’ve built or meaningfully contributed to an LLM evaluation pipeline — LLM-as-judge design, calibration against human labels, dataset versioning, and the statistical reasoning behind it (CIs, sample sizes, false positives).

  • You write production-grade Python (FastAPI, PostgreSQL).

  • You’ve worked with at least two of Anthropic, OpenAI/Azure, Bedrock, or Vertex AI.

  • You’re familiar with Langfuse, LangSmith, or similar tracing tools.

  • You handle reliability when it shows up in your work — retries, error handling, graceful degradation. SLO thinking is a plus.

  • You communicate clearly and push back when you disagree.

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come to work every day, and be prepared to share with us how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our Agentic Ants team.

jobs.title: Operations Manager in Remote E-Commerce Agentur (m/w/d) · Remote
jobs.excerpt: Das ist dein Job bei unsIm wöchentlichen Check-in siehst du, dass drei Projekte für das Quartal seit zwei Wochen stillstehen.
jobs.description:
Das ist dein Job bei uns

Im wöchentlichen Check-in siehst du, dass drei Projekte für das Quartal seit zwei Wochen stillstehen. Niemand hat den Status und den Fortschritt aktualisiert. Du fragst nicht nach dem Status. Du schaust in den Prozess dahinter.

Du gehst den Ablauf mit dem Teamlead durch. Die Zahlen für das Projekt liegen in drei Tools. Jemand muss sie jeden Montag von Hand zusammentragen. Also passiert es nicht.

Du baust den Ablauf neu. In ClickUp entsteht ein Workflow mit klaren Verantwortlichen und Fristen. Die Zahlen laufen über Make automatisch in ein Dashboard. Das baust du mit Ali und Arthur aus unserem Prozess-Team. Die SOP dazu schreibst du selbst.

Im Reporting an Lukas aus der Geschäftsführung liegt der Zielfortschritt jetzt jede Woche auf dem Tisch und das Team arbeitet deutlich effizienter.

Einen Tag später nimmst du dir den nächsten Bottleneck vor. Nicht, weil sich jemand beschwert, sondern weil dir ineffiziente Prozesse ins Auge springen. Du schaffst dem ganzen Team Freiräume.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir wollen der stärkste ganzheitliche Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum sein.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.

Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote und seit dem ersten Tag.

Was dich hier erwartet

Du baust nicht nur die Prozesse im Hintergrund. Du sorgst im Alltag dafür, dass unser Unternehmen und das gesamte Team reibungsloser funktionieren: Deadlines werden eingehalten, Aufgaben abgeschlossen, Projekte kommen voran.

Denn die besten Prozesse bringen nichts, wenn niemand nachhält, ob sie greifen. Genau das ist deine Aufgabe.

Was das im Alltag heißt:

  • Du übersetzt die Jahres- und Quartalsziele in konkrete Maßnahmen, Meilensteine und Checklisten. So bleibt die Strategie im Alltag greifbar.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass das EVOLVE OS als ganzheitliches System und Kern unserer Dienstleistung funktioniert und sich fortlaufend weiterentwickelt

  • Du steuerst die operativen Abläufe vor allem innerhalb der Agentur und bei Bedarf zusätzlich in Finance und People Ops, von Rechnungswesen über Onboarding.

  • Du entwickelst KPI-Dashboards und Übersichten, wo sie benötigt und sinnvoll sind.

  • Du führst neue Automationen und Prozesse über Claude, Make und n8n ein. Für die Umsetzung stellen wir dir ein Team zur Verfügung.

  • Du betreibst das OKR-System im Alltag: Reminder, Check-ins, Dashboards. Ziele, die niemand nachhält, bleiben.

  • Zusammen mit den Teamleads gehst du Bottlenecks im Tagesgeschäft durch und löst sie an der Wurzel, nicht mit einem Pflaster.

Der letzte Punkt ist uns wichtig. Diese Rolle gibt es bei uns nur einmal, deshalb bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen allen sechs Fachbereichen, nicht nur zu einem Team.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projekt- und Prozessmanagement, idealerweise im Agentur- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld.

  • Du kennst dich mit Projektmanagement-Tools wie ClickUp oder Asana aus und verstehst in den Grundzügen Automation-Tools wie Make oder n8n.

  • Analytisches und systemisches Denken mit Controlling-Grundlagen. Du siehst nicht nur die Kennzahl, sondern auch, was dahinter steckt.

  • Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, da wir 100 % remote arbeiten.

  • Klare, strukturierte Kommunikation nach innen und außen. Du arbeitest mit Team Leads auf Augenhöhe an ihren Prozessen, ohne sie disziplinarisch zu führen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Google-Tabellen und Excel für Auswertungen und Datenstrukturen.

  • Hohe Affinität für AI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude und Co. Du nutzt sie, um Systeme zu bauen und Probleme zu lösen, nicht nur ,um Texte zu erstellen.

Direkt gesagt: Dieser Job passt nicht zu jedem

Du solltest dich nicht bewerben, wenn dir das Tagesgeschäft zu kleinteilig ist. Diese Rolle lebt von Prozessen und Details, nicht von reiner Strategiearbeit.

Du bist bei uns auch nicht richtig, wenn dir Prozessmanagement noch komplett fremd ist. Genau diese Erfahrung macht hier den Unterschied.

Der Rahmen

  • Klare Entwicklungsperspektive Richtung Head of Operations

  • 100 % Remote seit Tag 1, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie Unterstützung durch interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

  • Zweimal jährlich Teamevents und Workations

So läuft der Prozess

Deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Wenn wir Rückfragen haben, schicken wir dir einen kurzen Fragebogen.

Erstgespräch. Ein kurzes Video-Gespräch mit Vanessa aus unserem HR: gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmen und Erwartungen.

Fachgespräch. Hier geht es in die Tiefe, mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Head of Operations.

Finales Kennenlernen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem zukünftigen Ansprechpartner, persönlich und fachlich. Hier definieren wir deine Stelle noch einmal genau auf Basis deiner Stärken und Interessen.

Entscheidung und Start. Wir entscheiden schnell und planen dein Onboarding gemeinsam.

Deine Entwicklung bei uns

Kurzfristig, die ersten zwei Monate. Du lernst die Abläufe unserer sechs Fachbereiche kennen. Du übernimmst das Zielsystem im Alltag: Check-ins, Reminder, Dashboards.

Mittelfristig. Du verantwortest Prozesse und Automationen in deinen Bereichen eigenständig. Dazu kommt die operative Steuerung der Finance- und People-Ops-Abläufe.

Langfristig. Fachlaufbahn mit Schwerpunkt Systeme und Automation. Oder Führungslaufbahn in Richtung Head of Operations, sobald Zielsystem, Prozesslandschaft und KPI-Landschaft stehen. Beide Wege entstehen durch Ergebnisse und nicht durch Wartezeit.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

performance-minded marketer. You will own Defend’s organic social presence across
platforms, create content that feels native to each channel, engage directly with our customers
and prospects, and use performance data to continually improve what we publish.

someone who can spot an opportunity, pick up a camera or phone, create the content, publish it,
engage with the audience, study the results, and make the next piece better.

    responding to fast-moving opportunities.

Become a part of our caring community

With over 10 million sales interactions annually, Humana understands that while great products are important, it’s the quality of our service that truly defines us. We know that when our members and prospects have delightful and memorable experiences, it strengthens their connection with us and enables us to put their Health First. After all, a health services company that has multiple ways to improve the lives of its customers is uniquely positioned to put those customers at the center of everything it does.

The Senior Product Owner is responsible for maximizing the value of products delivered by Agile teams by defining product direction, prioritizing work, and ensuring alignment between stakeholder needs and delivery outcomes. This role works across business, technology, operations, and delivery teams to clarify objectives, evaluate tradeoffs, and guide product capabilities from concept through implementation and ongoing improvement.
Serving as the primary product decision-maker for the Agile team, the Senior Product Owner owns the product backlog, defines features and user stories, establishes acceptance criteria, and prioritizes work based on business value, feasibility, risk, cost, and timing. The role ensures the team has the information and direction needed to deliver the right product capabilities in the right sequence.
The Senior Product Owner also begins to influence department strategy by identifying product opportunities, improving prioritization practices, supporting roadmap development, and helping align delivery efforts to broader business goals. Work is performed with minimal direction, and the role requires sound judgment, strong stakeholder partnership, and the ability to make decisions on moderately complex to complex issues.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and communicate product vision, goals, roadmap priorities, and expected outcomes.
  • Own, manage, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, stakeholder needs, feasibility, risk, cost, and timing.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, clarify requirements, and align delivery work to strategic objectives.
  • Translate business needs into features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable team priorities.
  • Serve as the Agile team’s primary point of contact for product decisions, requirement clarification, and prioritization.
  • Evaluate tradeoffs and make informed decisions to balance value, scope, schedule, budget, risk, and delivery constraints.
  • Collaborate with technology, operations, business, analytics, compliance, and other cross-functional partners as needed.
  • Support product planning, release planning, implementation readiness, adoption, and ongoing product improvement.
  • Monitor progress toward outcomes and use data, feedback, and stakeholder input to inform future priorities.
  • Influence departmental strategy by identifying opportunities to improve products, processes, and delivery effectiveness.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience as a product owner
  • 5+ years of experience driving large scale implementations in Agile and/or waterfall methodologies
  • Experience interacting with various levels of upper management to inform product prioritization
  • Experience in translating product features to user stories

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree
  • In-depth understanding of the healthcare insurance industry and the application of AI in this sector.

  • Experience working within a scaled agile framework (e.g., SAFe®) is highly preferred
  • Proficiency with agile tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps) and a data-driven approach to prioritization and decision making.

40

Data Engineering & Integration (25%)

  • Maintain reporting documentation, metadata, data dictionaries, and reporting lifecycle management processes.

·

Analytics, Trend Analysis & Insights (20%)

  • Perform trend analysis across contact center operational, financial, workforce, and customer experience metrics.

  • Identify trends, anomalies, root causes, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Develop forecasting models and support workforce planning activities.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations to operational leaders and executive stakeholders.
  • Design and monitor key performance indicators supporting business objectives.

AI-Enabled Analytics & Innovation (15%)

  • Evaluate and implement AI-enabled analytics solutions to improve reporting automation, insight generation, anomaly detection, and decision support.
  • Design datasets and semantic models optimized for natural language querying and AI-powered analytics experiences.
  • Utilize Microsoft Copilot, Power BI AI capabilities, Microsoft Fabric, and approved enterprise AI platforms to enhance reporting and analytics workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual analytics processes through generative AI and workflow automation.
  • Develop AI-assisted reporting templates, prompt libraries, and reusable insight-generation frameworks.
  • Support implementation of conversational analytics and natural-language reporting capabilities.
  • Research emerging AI, machine learning, and analytics technologies and recommend practical business applications.

Business Partnership, Consulting & Project Support (10%)

  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and define analytics solutions.
  • Translate business objectives into scalable reporting and data strategies.
  • Present insights, recommendations, and reporting results to operational and executive leadership.
  • Participate in project planning, testing, user acceptance testing, and implementation activities.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for contact center analytics and reporting.

Governance & Documentation (5%)

  • Maintain documentation for reports, dashboards, datasets, KPIs, integrations, and data models.
  • Establish and enforce reporting standards and best practices.
  • Support audit and compliance activities related to reporting and data management.

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science or related field required. Equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a formal degree.

EXPERIENCE

  • 3+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, Analytics Engineering, Software Development, or related technical disciplines.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting SQL Server databases, including views, stored procedures, functions, query optimization, database performance tuning, and analytical data structures.
