jobs.description:
Ideal start timeline: August 2026

Role status: Exempt

Compensation: Our target hiring range is $180,000-$200,000 plus participation in our Annual Bonus Program with eligibility for $12,000 bonus. Actual compensation will be commensurate with experience and skills.

Campminder’s Flexible Working Location: Our employees have the option to work 100% remotely within the United States or their choice of days at home and at our office in Boulder, Colorado. We host a variety of all-company hybrid meetings and social events. We require anybody working remotely to have a very reliable, high-speed internet connection.

We know the best people can choose to work anywhere.

Here’s a few reasons why 100+ of them choose Campminder:

  • With 20+ years experience of serving the industry through its digital transformation, we’re stable, profitable, and have developed a loyal customer base (that continues to grow).
  • We build software for summer camps, an industry that enables meaningful experiences for kids.
  • We work on interesting, ambitious projects that create real value for our clients.
  • We know our team members feel their work has an impact on the organization’s purpose.
  • At the same time, we are genuinely committed to work/life balance. Our team members feel they have the flexibility to take time off when needed and feel supported in making use of flexible working arrangements.
  • We invest in emerging technology and cutting-edge leadership and are proud to take an "AI-Enabled" approach in our solutions.
  • We’ve been listed on Outside Magazine’s 50 Best Places to Work for 8 consecutive years for our values-led culture and employee experience.

This role’s mission & overview:
Camps trust Campminder to keep their data safe, and that trust is what lets them focus on running a great summer. You'll own how we protect that data end to end: architecting and hardening our security infrastructure, carrying our PCI and SOC2 programs through every audit, and setting the roadmap that keeps us ahead of real threats. You'll be the person the engineering org comes to on security and the one who defines what good looks like at Campminder.

As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer on our Engineering team, you will:

  • Partner with the DevOps team to Integrate security scanning (SAST, DAST, SCA) into CI/CD pipelines and drive remediation before code reaches production
  • Configure, tune, and harden WAF rules across our web applications
  • Partner with platform and IT to implement and maintain EDR, DLP, vulnerability scanning and remediation, and SIEM/XDR tooling across servers and endpoints
  • Manage secrets and credentials in build pipelines, including vault-based storage, rotation, and least-privilege service accounts
  • Execute PCI, SOC2, and ISO technical controls: SAQ completion, quarterly ASV scans, and disaster recovery implementation
  • Harden containerized and cloud-native environments, including image scanning and Kubernetes configuration
  • Coordinate pen testing engagements and drive remediation against SLA timelines
  • Run security awareness training programs (KnowBe4, Security Journey) and maintain AI usage oversight, including approved tooling, code-gen governance, and supply-chain monitoring

We think a successful candidate will bring:

  • Experienced in security engineering or DevSecOps, with hands-on ownership of both pipeline-level and infrastructure-level security
  • Experience configuring IAM and SSO platforms (Okta, Auth0) alongside cloud-native identity controls like Azure conditional access
  • Comfort embedding security directly into CI/CD workflows through security and dependency scanning tooling, secrets management, and policy-as-code
  • A track record of hardening containerized and cloud-native environments, including Kubernetes and image scanning
  • Experience executing PCI, SOC2 or similar compliance technical controls (scans, SAQs, evidence prep); program ownership isn't required, but you know how to translate auditor requirements into engineering work
  • Familiarity administering centralized cybersecurity solutions, endpoint security, and data loss protection
  • Strong judgement on how to balance security risk with employee experience and velocity, how to build trust through balanced approaches to security risk mitigation, and knowledge of when to escalate versus fix directly
  • Experience running or supporting security awareness and training programs
  • Exposure to AI tooling governance, such as MCP inventories, code-gen release gating, or supply-chain monitoring for AI-assisted development
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to technical and non-technical people
  • A track record of working collaboratively with engineers and supporting them in learning and implementing security best practices
  • A track record of empowering delivery teams to move quickly and unblock themselves
  • A growth-oriented mindset

Our Interview Process:

  1. 45 min - interview with People & Culture
  2. 60 min - interview with Hiring Manager
  3. Phase 3
    1. 60 min - Technical interview
    2. 30 min - Peer interview
    3. 30 min - Interview with our CTO

A few of the benefits we are proud to offer:

  • Robust medical, dental, and vision coverage options with generous employer contributions, plus a $500 employer HSA contribution for HSA-compatible plans
  • Ability to choose where you work - remotely, in the office, or a mix!
  • A variety of resources to support mental health and emotional well-being
  • 12 weeks of 100% paid parental leave for all new parents, including via adoption, surrogacy, and foster care
  • 401(k) with 4% company matching
  • Trust-Based (flexible) PTO (and yes, we use it!)
  • $900/year wellness allowance
  • Company-paid subscriptions, training, and support for using AI professionally and personally. We have a team dedicated to enabling our AI capabilities for our team members and our customers!

We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply:

We're actively taking steps to make sure our culture is inclusive and that our processes and practices promote equity for all, including people of color, people from working-class backgrounds, women, and members of the LGBTQ+ community. We welcome and encourage applications from people with these identities or members of other historically marginalized groups.

Research shows that women and people of color tend not to apply to jobs unless they believe they are 100% qualified and apply to fewer senior-level positions. With that in mind, we encourage you to apply if you're not sure whether you meet our qualifications. We'd love to have the opportunity to consider you!

We encourage applications from parents, parents-to-be, and those responsible for the caretaking of others. We offer paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents (including for adoption, surrogacy, and foster care placement) and paid loss leave to recover from miscarriage or stillbirth. The company's HSA and wellness allowance contributions may be used toward childcare, eldercare, adoption fees, and fertility treatments like IVF, among other expenses.

jobs.description:
Das ist dein Job bei uns

Bei der Analyse eines Google-Ads-Accounts fällt dir auf, dass ein Kunde mit einer Produktgruppe gar kein Geld verdient, obwohl der ROAS gut aussieht. Du gehst der Sache auf den Grund und stellst fest, dass die Marge dieser Gruppe deutlich schlechter ist als im Rest des Sortiments.

Du entwickelst eine neue Kampagnenstruktur, holst dir im Fachbereich noch zwei Impulse dazu und baust anschließend um. Das Reporting passt du gleich mit an.

Ein paar Tage später stellst du den neuen Aufbau dem Geschäftsführer des Unternehmens selbst vor. Er ist begeistert und du setzt mit Unterstützung aus dem EVOLVE Team um.

Eine Woche später fällt dir auf, dass du dieselbe Auswertung inzwischen zum dritten Mal manuell gebaut hast. Du sprichst mit Ali und Arthur aus unserem AI-Team und ihr automatisiert sie. Ab jetzt steht sie dem gesamten EVOLVE-Team auf Knopfdruck zur Verfügung.

Am Ende des Monats sind deine Kunden zufrieden, weil die Zahlen stimmen. Du hast viel gelernt und das EVOLVE-Team auch.

Genau das ist der Job.

Wofür wir arbeiten

Wir wollen der stärkste ganzheitliche Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum sein.

Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke. Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote und seit dem ersten Tag.

Wir denken Google Ads anders

Bei EVOLVE arbeiten wir daran, das reine Kampagnenmanagement so weit wie möglich an AI und Automatisierung zu übergeben. Nicht, um Menschen zu ersetzen, sondern um ihnen die Zeit für das zurückzugeben, was tatsächlich über Wachstum entscheidet:

  • Steuerung auf Deckungsbeitrag statt auf Kanal-Kennzahlen, die gut aussehen

  • Wachstumshebel jenseits des Google-Ads-Kontos wie Landingpages, Feeds, Angebotslogik und Funnel

  • Skalierung über YouTube, Display und Demand Gen, wo die meisten Wettbewerber gar nicht erst hinschauen

Genau dafür suchen wir jemanden.

Was dich hier erwartet

Du übernimmst nicht „ein paar Accounts". Du übernimmst Verantwortung für das Wachstum deiner Kunden im Google-Kanal, von der Analyse über die Strategie bis zur Umsetzung. Wie du dorthin kommst, entscheidest du. Denn wir werden nicht dafür bezahlt, Kampagnen zu verwalten. Wir werden dafür bezahlt, dass unsere Kunden wachsen: dass Budgets profitabel steigen, dass mehr Umsatz entsteht und am Ende mehr Profit übrig bleibt.

Was das im Alltag heißt:

  • Du steuerst und skalierst Google-Ads-Kampagnen profitabel über Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen und YouTube

  • Du erhöhst Budgets dort, wo sie profitabel wachsen, und erkennst die Grenzen, an denen es kippt

  • Du optimierst auf Deckungsbeitrag statt auf ROAS, weil unsere Kunden Geld verdienen wollen und keine Kennzahlen

  • Du führst deine Kunden strategisch und berätst eigenständig auf Entscheiderebene

  • Du arbeitest mit unserem internen AI-Stack für Analyse, Kampagnensteuerung und Reporting und entwickelst ihn mit weiter

  • Du bringst deine Erkenntnisse zurück ins Team und prägst mit, wie EVOLVE im Google-Kanal arbeitet

Der letzte Punkt ist uns wichtig. Was du herausfindest, bleibt nicht in deinem Account. Es wird Teil der Methodik, mit der das ganze Team arbeitet.

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre praktische Google-Ads-Erfahrung im E-Commerce, als Hauptkanal und nicht nebenbei

  • Analytisches Denken und schnelle Mustererkennung. Du siehst in Daten Zusammenhänge und nicht nur Zahlen

  • Die Bereitschaft, deine Arbeitsweise durch AI unterstützen zu lassen. Idealerweise probierst du dich bereits mit Skills, Skripten oder MCP-Connections aus

  • Sicherheit im direkten Kundenkontakt bis auf Geschäftsführungsebene

  • Sehr gute Selbstorganisation, denn bei 100 % Remote gibt es niemanden, der dich antreibt

Direkt gesagt: Dieser Job passt nicht zu jedem

Du solltest dich nicht bewerben, wenn dir Durchschnitt reicht. Wir tragen Entwicklung im Namen und meinen das ernst, fachlich, menschlich und in deiner Karriere. Du bist bei uns auch nicht richtig, wenn du Kunden nur oberflächlich betreuen möchtest oder rein im Silo-Denken innerhalb des Google-Ads-Kanals unterwegs bist.

Und nicht, wenn du AI für einen Hype hältst, den man aussitzen kann. Dafür ist hier der falsche Ort.

Der Rahmen

  • 100 % Remote seit Tag 1, kein Hybrid-Kompromiss

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Laptop deiner Wahl und hochwertige Homeoffice-Ausstattung

  • Weiterbildungsbudget sowie Unterstützung durch interne und externe Quellen und Mentoren an deiner Seite

  • Voller Zugriff auf unseren internen AI-Stack

  • Zweimal jährlich Teamevents und Workations

So läuft der Prozess

  1. Deine Bewerbung. Dein Lebenslauf reicht. Wenn wir Rückfragen haben, schicken wir dir einen kurzen Fragebogen.

  2. Erstgespräch. Ein kurzes Video-Gespräch mit Vanessa aus unserem HR: gegenseitiges Kennenlernen, Rahmen und Erwartungen.

  3. Fachgespräch. Hier geht es in die Tiefe, mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Lead deines Fachbereichs.

  4. Finales Kennenlernen. Mit der Geschäftsführung und deinem zukünftigen Ansprechpartner, persönlich und fachlich. Hier definieren wir deine Stelle noch einmal genau auf Basis deiner Stärken und Interessen.

  5. Entscheidung und Start. Wir entscheiden schnell und planen dein Onboarding gemeinsam.

Deine Entwicklung bei uns

Kurzfristig, die ersten zwei Monate. Du lernst unsere EVOLVE-Methodik kennen und arbeitest eng mit dem Team an ersten Projekten.

Mittelfristig. Du betreust eigene Projekte vollständig eigenständig und ganzheitlich. Google Ads ist dein Hauptfokus, aber du verstehst auch, welche Hebel über den Kanal hinaus für deine Kunden entscheidend sind.

Langfristig. Du machst bei uns Karriere, entweder in der Fachlaufbahn oder in der Führungslaufbahn. Beide Wege entstehen durch Ergebnisse und nicht durch Wartezeit.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin

Vanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

jobs.description:
Databricks Architect — Senior / Specialist

The Role

We're seeking a Databricks Architect (Senior/Specialist level) to serve as a senior technical authority for data architecture and analytics engineering on the Databricks Lakehouse platform across Cognify Analytics and our client engagements. In this role, you will design and own Databricks-based data platform architecture, lead complex data engineering initiatives, and ensure our data capabilities are enterprise-grade, governed, and future-ready. You will bridge data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML — combining deep hands-on expertise in Databricks, Python, and SQL with strong architectural judgment and stakeholder communication.

Must-Have Skills (Non-Negotiable)

  • Databricks — hands-on architecture and engineering experience on the Databricks Lakehouse Platform (production-grade, at scale)

  • Python — strong professional proficiency for data engineering and pipeline development

  • SQL — advanced proficiency for data modeling, transformation, and performance tuning

Candidates without demonstrable, hands-on experience in all three of the above will not be considered.

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture and design of Databricks-based data platforms, including lakehouse design (Delta Lake), medallion architecture, and unified analytics layers.

  • Serve as the senior technical authority on Databricks platform design, providing guidance on architecture, tooling, modeling, and engineering standards across teams and projects.

  • Design and build ingestion, transformation, and orchestration pipelines using Python, SQL, PySpark, and Databricks Workflows.

  • Architect data mesh and data product strategies, defining domain ownership, data contracts, and self-service consumption patterns on Databricks.

  • Establish and evangelize best practices across the data lifecycle: ingestion, transformation, modeling, quality, observability, governance, and consumption.

  • Drive the integration of Databricks with AI/ML capabilities, including feature engineering pipelines, vector data infrastructure for RAG, and MLflow-based model workflows.

  • Lead complex data migration, platform modernization, and consolidation initiatives for enterprise clients across industries.

  • Evaluate emerging data technologies (Apache Iceberg, Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Mosaic AI) to inform architectural decisions.

  • Solve complex, ambiguous, high-impact data architecture problems that span multiple teams, platforms, or organizational boundaries.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment between data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, platform engineering, security, and product teams.

  • Mentor senior data engineers and analysts, fostering a culture of technical excellence.

  • Represent Cognify Analytics in discussions with client stakeholders and leadership on data capabilities, strategy, and technical roadmaps.

  • Define and enforce data governance, compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2), and responsible data management standards across all Databricks environments.

  • Drive FinOps maturity for the Databricks platform, including compute optimization, cluster policies, storage lifecycle management, and cost forecasting.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or equivalent professional experience in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field.

  • 6–9 years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data architecture, with demonstrated technical leadership on at least a few large-scale engagements.

  • Mandatory, hands-on expertise in Databricks, Python, and SQL in production environments.

  • Strong working knowledge of the modern data stack: dbt, Airflow/Dagster, Fivetran/Airbyte, Spark, Kafka, and cloud-native data services.

  • Solid grasp of data modeling methodologies (Kimball, Data Vault, Activity Schema, OBT) and the judgment to apply them across contexts.

  • Experience with cloud data infrastructure on AWS, Azure, or GCP (any combination is acceptable, alongside Databricks).

  • Proven ability to influence technical direction and align technical and business stakeholders on complex architecture topics.

  • Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, cataloging, lineage, and regulatory compliance frameworks.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and contributing to a high-performing data team.

  • Strong understanding of how data platforms serve AI/ML workloads, including feature engineering, vector data, and model input/output pipelines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience architecting Databricks-based platforms that directly serve LLM-based systems, RAG pipelines, and agentic AI architectures at enterprise scale.

  • Deep familiarity with lakehouse table formats: Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and Apache Hudi.

  • Track record of implementing data mesh, data product, or federated data governance patterns.

  • Experience with real-time analytics and streaming architectures: Kafka, Flink, Spark Structured Streaming.

  • Experience with advanced Databricks features: Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables, Databricks Workflows, MLflow, and Mosaic AI.

  • Contributions to open-source data projects, data architecture publications, or industry standards bodies.

  • Background in financial services, healthcare, SaaS, or enterprise consulting requiring high data compliance, security, and operational rigor.

  • Experience leading data engineering across geographically distributed teams and multi-client engagements.

Why Join Cognify Analytics?

  • Join a team of industry veterans from Google, Meta, and top-tier tech companies.

  • Work on impactful, high-scale data and analytics projects with leading global clients.

  • Enjoy a flexible, remote-first culture focused on innovation and excellence.

  • Competitive salary, equity options, and continuous learning opportunities.

  • Shape the future of modern data platforms and AI-powered analytics at a rapidly growing company.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.description:
Help build the future of circular technology.
At Pandas, we’re building the technology behind the next generation of smartphone trade-ins.

Our mission is simple:

For every smartphone that’s purchased, another one should be traded in, just as easily.
We develop AI-powered solutions that help some of the world’s largest retailers assess, value and trade in mobile devices more efficiently, making device reuse faster, smarter and more sustainable.
As we continue expanding internationally, we’re looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, working with technology, and making a real operational impact.
If you’re analytical, detail-oriented, naturally curious, and passionate about smartphones, we’d love to meet you.
⸻

About the Role

As an Operations Specialist, you’ll play a key role in the daily operation and quality of our AI-powered trade-in platform.

This is not a traditional customer support role.

Your work will combine operational monitoring, AI quality validation, partner support, and problem solving. You’ll review and assess grading sessions performed by our AI, investigate operational issues, help partners resolve day-to-day challenges, and work closely with our Product and Engineering teams to continuously improve our platform.

Success in this role comes from analytical thinking, consistency, attention to detail, and a genuine interest in technology.
⸻

What You’ll Do

  • Review and assess smartphone grading sessions and grading results generated by our AI platform to ensure quality and consistency.
  • Monitor the daily performance of our global trade-in platform and identify operational issues.
  • Investigate platform behaviour, grading discrepancies, and partner-reported issues.
  • Support business partners via our support platform, email, and phone, helping them resolve operational and product-related questions.
  • Guide partners through structured troubleshooting procedures.
  • Escalate complex issues to Product or Engineering when necessary.
  • Identify recurring issues and contribute ideas that improve our products, processes, and operational efficiency.
  • Maintain high quality standards by following documented procedures and continuously improving best practices.

⸻

A Typical Day

A typical day may include:

  • Reviewing AI-generated smartphone grading results.
  • Investigating grading discrepancies and unusual cases.
  • Helping retail partners troubleshoot platform-related issues.
  • Monitoring operational performance across multiple markets.
  • Collaborating with Product and Engineering on product improvements.
  • Testing newly released features and providing feedback.
  • Updating internal documentation and operational processes.

No two days are exactly the same, but every day you’ll directly contribute to improving the reliability of our AI platform and the experience of our partners around the world.

⸻

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • Fluent written and spoken French.
  • Professional written and spoken English.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Comfortable working with technology and learning new software.
  • Passion for smartphones and consumer technology.
  • Ability to follow structured procedures consistently.
  • Comfortable making independent decisions.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Availability during French retail business hours.

Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following is considered an advantage:

  • Operations
  • Customer Support
  • Helpdesk
  • Quality Assurance
  • Telecommunications
  • Consumer Electronics
  • Mobile Retail
  • Device Repair or Refurbishment

Knowledge of Android and iOS devices is also considered a strong advantage.

⸻

You’ll Enjoy This Role If…

  • You enjoy solving problems and investigating how things work.
  • You naturally notice details that others miss.
  • You’re interested in AI and emerging technologies.
  • You enjoy improving processes rather than simply following them.
  • You like balancing analytical work with communication.
  • You take pride in making accurate and consistent decisions.
  • You want to be part of a growing international technology company where your work has visible impact.

⸻

What We Offer

  • Competitive full-time salary.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Self-development budget for courses, books, conferences, and certifications.
  • Refurbished smartphone.
  • Top-of-the-line equipment.
  • Flexible work location (remote, hybrid, or on-site).
  • Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing international technology company.
  • A collaborative environment where your ideas genuinely influence our products and operations.

⸻

Why Join Pandas?

At Pandas, Operations isn’t just about keeping things running.

Our Operations team works at the intersection of AI, technology, product quality, and partner experience. Every grading session you review, every issue you investigate, and every improvement you suggest helps shape the future of our platform.

If you’re looking for a role where you’ll learn, grow, and make a measurable impact every day, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Please click"Apply Now"to respond to the initial questions in the application form and submit your CV / Resume and cover letter. We ask that you spend no more than 2 hours preparing your responses to the prompts.

Application Deadline:Sunday, August 30, 2026, at the end of the day (23:59) Anywhere on Earth (UTC-12:00).

About the Role

Our staff's time is one of RP's tightest bottlenecks. Over the last year, AI tools have crossed a threshold where they can meaningfully accelerate serious knowledge and administrative work. But they're also uneven, and it's easy to feel faster while producing plausible-sounding work that doesn't hold up. As an organisation that cares about getting things right, we don't want to adopt AI on vibes. We want to know, rigorously, where it genuinely improves our work and where it doesn't.
That's what this role is for. You'll lead RP's effort to figure out — empirically — which of our research and operational tasks AI can reliably and usefully augment, build and deploy the tools and workflows that prove out, and steer us away from the ones that don't. This is as much a measurement and research problem as an adoption one, which is why we want someone who understands both research rigor and the real capabilities and limits of modern AI tooling.
You'll be the lead for this area at RP and will report to the Principal Research Director, David Moss.

The role may be offered at a more junior or more senior level (and titled accordingly) depending on the successful candidate's experience

Hours and term: Our default is full-time on an initial 12-month contract with the possibility of extension. We're open to part-time for the right person, and open to a shorter initial term with the option to re-engage afterwards. Tell us what arrangement works for you.

Contact: Please email if you have any questions.

What you'll do

  • Own RP's strategy for using AI in our work. Propose and prioritise where to invest, set the direction, and be the directly responsible individual for how AI is used across the organisation.
  • Design and run rigorous, decision-relevant evaluations. Test AI tools and workflows against the work we actually do, measuring real effects on quality, speed, and reliability, not just adoption or self-reported time savings. Distinguish clearly what AI can be trusted to do from what it can't.
  • Build and prototype. Get hands-on with agentic tooling (e.g. Claude Code), plugins, MCP integrations, and lightweight internal tools — first to test approaches, then to scale the ones that work.
  • Partner with teams across RP. Sit with researchers and operational staff to understand their workflows in detail, surface high-value use cases, and embed what works into day-to-day practice.
  • Turn findings into guidance. Translate evaluation results into clear, current advice, policy, and training, and raise the organisation's overall AI fluency.
  • Assess safety and security of AI tools. Identify risks from AI tool use, including cybersecurity, data protection and legal compliance, and document clear recommendations for handling them.
  • Stay ahead of a fast-moving field and keep RP's approach evidence-led rather than hype-led.

Who we're looking for

This role sits at the intersection of research and engineering, so we're looking for genuine strength in both of the following — though, as noted below, the balance can tilt in either direction.
Research judgment. You understand what rigorous research looks like, how that differs across domains, and why a slick-looking AI output can still be wrong in ways that matter. You can design fair, decision-relevant tests and change your mind based on the results.
Technical fluency. You're genuinely hands-on with modern AI tooling, comfortable working with agentic coding tools like Claude Code, building plugins and MCP integrations, and writing the scripts needed to wring real capability out of these systems and to evaluate them properly.
We'd also expect:
  • A self-directed, experimental disposition, happy owning an ambiguous, fast-evolving mandate without a playbook.
  • Familiarity with effective-altruism-style research and RP's priorities to judge where AI genuinely helps.
  • Comfort working in a fully remote, globally distributed senior role.

Two ways to be a strong fit

We expect most candidates to lean one of two ways, and we're open to both:
  • A researcher who's fluent in AI — someone with a solid research background in cause prioritization research who has gone deep on AI tooling.
  • A technically strong builder with EA literacy — someone with strong engineering and AI-tooling skills who is engaged with the cause prioritization research space.
If you're strong on one axis and credible on the other, we want to hear from you.

Nice to have

  • Prior experience in AI enablement, evaluation, or applied AI/ML.
  • A software engineering background or a track record of building internal tools.
  • Direct experience with one or more of RP's research domains (animal welfare, AI safety and strategy, global health and wellbeing, and general cause prioritization).

What We Offer

Compensation
  • We offer an annual salary between $132,986-$146,447 USD pre-tax for a full-time position, prorated for part-time work.
  • The exact salary will be based on the candidate’s prior relevant experience and corresponding title level, and calculated using RP’s salary algorithm.
  • Compensation is not restricted to the currencies listed above.
  • To ensure fairness across the entire organization, RP does not negotiate salaries.
Other Benefits
  • Opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, high-impact organization — our research is used by key decision-makers who influence the distribution of hundreds of millions of charitable dollars.
  • Remote-first environment, including flexible work hours and schedule.
  • Comprehensive global benefits program, including statutory benefits specific to a local country, as mandated by local law, and supplemental benefits, as available
  • Generous paid time off (PTO) and unpaid leave, including:
    • Statutory paid and unpaid leave (as applicable)
    • Unlimited (within reason) personal and sick paid and unpaid leave
    • “Mandated” mid- and end-year, organization-wide breaks (if the temporary employment contract falls within the break timeline)
    • Other paid and unpaid leave (e.g., bereavement)
  • Annual technology stipend of the equivalent of $500 USD that can be used to cover costs of purchasing work and office equipment
  • Learning opportunities, including workshops / training sessions
  • Virtual co-working spaces, including a private Rethink Priorities Focusmate group
  • RP Peer Support Program for New Employees.
  • Other benefits at the discretion of RP Leadership.
  • A caring team that values respectful work relations and a healthy work-life balance.
  • Opportunities to grow/advance your career and engage in professional development.
  • Low administrative bureaucracy.
  • We don’t provide snacks, but we could mail you a box of Oreos if you want!

Our Hiring Process


Stage 1 — Initial Screening.
To be considered for this role, we ask for the following, which you can complete on the application page:
  1. A C.V.
    1. We recommend you update your CV to include all prior relevant roles and work as CV’s will be evaluated for this role.
  2. A cover letter briefly describing your suitability for the role
    1. In particular, we'd like to hear about your strengths on the two axes described above: your hands-on experience with AI tooling (whether deploying it across an organisation, in research or operations workflows, or in your own work), and your research background, especially where it relates to RP's domains. As noted, we expect most candidates to lean one way — tell us which, and what makes you credible on the other. Bullet points are welcome.
  3. Relevant prior work you think would showcase your suitability
    1. You can upload documents/ share links on the application page
  4. No more than 1000 words addressing the following question:
    1. Rethink Priorities works across a variety of domains (AI, animal welfare, global health, cross-cause prioritisation), and methodologies (drawing on empirical literature, quantitative modeling, and philosophical theorising). With reference to some concrete research task conducted by Rethink Priorities, outline how you would evaluate the extent to which AI can be used to complete this task.
    2. Please see the application page for detailed instructions and the evaluation criteria.
Stage 2 — Paid Skills Assessment.
  • You will complete a standardized, time-boxed task that mimics the actual job (3–5 hours)
  • You’ll be paid $45 per hour for the test task
Stage 3 — Interview
  • We will ask you questions across the skills and experience the role requires
  • You will have a chance to ask questions about the role, and RP broadly
Stage 4 — Reference Checks. We ask two references about your work

We hope to hire for this role by end of September.

Additional Information

Role-Specific

  • Work Environment and Visa Sponsorship: This role is fully remote and we are able to legally hire in many countries. We are not able to sponsor visas for this role. Please email before submitting your application if you have questions about whether we can hire you in a specific country.
  • Time Zones and Working Hours: While we welcome applicants from all time zones, you may be expected to attend meetings with at least a two-hour overlap with UTC+2 working hours.
  • Language: Professional level of English language is required for all roles at Rethink Priorities.

Hiring-Process Specific

  • Extension requests: We will try to accommodate extension requests that are made before the deadline and are up to three (3) days. We generally cannot accommodate extension requests made after the application deadline, or are longer than 3 days, and cannot accept late submissions to ensure fairness to other applicants.

  • Inclusivity and fairness: RP is committed to building an inclusive, equitable, and supportive community for you to thrive and do your best work. Partner Identification & Market Research

Partner Qualification

Evaluate prospective pharmacy partners against Lumimeds' qualification criteria, including:

  • Active licensing and regulatory compliance

  • Operational capacity and turnaround times

CRM & Pipeline Management

Internal Collaboration

    • Business Development
    • Sales Development
    • Healthcare recruiting

Senior Land Survey Drafter
Location: Remote (Florida preferred), Hybrid, or In-office at West Palm Beach, FL

Job Type: Full-time

Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Company Overview:
Nexgen is a premier land surveying firm dedicated to expanding our presence throughout Florida by providing top-tier surveying, mapping, and geospatial services. We provide mortgage surveys to title agents and real estate attorneys as well as construction suverying services for residential projects. Our commitment to innovation, collaboration, and precision drives us to deliver exceptional results, fostering growth and success for our clients and communities. We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Senior Land Survey Drafter or SIT to join our dynamic and growing team.
Job Summary:
The Senior Land Survey Drafter serves as the central “traffic controller” and client advocate for all survey projects, overseeing workflow from client request through final delivery. In this role, this person manages outsourced research and drafting partners, ensuring projects are accurately scoped, properly assigned, delivered on schedule, and meet company quality standards. With production work handled externally, this position focuses on client communication, vendor coordination, quality assurance, and financial performance—balancing technical understanding with strong organizational and customer service skills to drive efficient, profitable project execution.

Why This Role is Different
No "Box" Time: The drafter is not expected to sit and draft; their value is in their eye for detail and ability to spot errors that others miss.
Profit Driver: Because they quote the work and manage the vendors, they are directly responsible for the cost-effectiveness of the survey department.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Customer Consultation & Quoting: Serve as the primary point of contact for clients; scope project requirements and deliver accurate cost estimates and timelines.
  • Outsourced Vendor Management: Distribute research tasks to due diligence partners and assign drafting projects to remote teams, ensuring all vendors have the necessary field data and client specs.
  • QA/QC Oversight: Utilize previous drafting experience to rigorously review and redline deliverables from outsourced teams, ensuring they meet company standards and local regulations before client delivery.
  • Technical Liaison: Translate complex client requests into clear instructions for drafting teams and resolve any technical discrepancies between field notes and office research.
  • Schedule & Budget Tracking: Monitor the progress of all active survey task orders, tracking vendor invoices and ensuring project margins remain healthy.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s or associate degree in surveying, geomatics, or a related field (preferred).
  • Drafting Background: Must have significant experience in CAD-based survey production (AutoCAD Civil 3D/Carlson) to effectively audit outsourced work and provide technical guidance.
  • Project Management: 1–5+ years in a coordination or management role within the land surveying industry.
  • Communication Skills: Proven ability to manage client expectations and maintain professional relationships with multiple external vendors.
  • Technical Fluency: Ability to analyze legal descriptions, title reports, and topographic data provided by outsourced due diligence teams.
  • Detail-oriented and able to work independently or as part of a team.

Compensation and Benefits:
  • Pay: $20.00 – $35.00 per hour, depending on experience (DOE)
  • After 60 days: Medical, Vision, Dental, and Company-paid basic life insurance. Accident, critical illness, hospital, term and whole life offered on a voluntary basis.
  • After 90 days: 401(k) savings program, Paid Time Off.
  • After 6 months: responsible charge hour accrual opportunities.

If you are a Senior Land Survey Drafter passionate about delivering exceptional service and meet the qualifications above, we encourage you to apply!

Als Werkstudent Planungsrecht & Research (m/w/d) unterstützt du ab dem 01.09.2026 das Product Team dabei, unseren KI-Agenten zu perfektionieren.   • Planungsrechtliche Recherche und Einordnung: Du verantwortest die inhaltliche Substanz des Datensatzes. Für reale Grundstücke ermittelst du, welche planungsrechtlichen Dokumente dort tatsächlich greifen: Bebauungspläne, Flächennutzungspläne, Erhaltungs- undGestaltungssatzungen und was in der jeweiligen Kommune sonst noch gilt. dein einstiegstermin und einsatzort

Engagement Responsibilities

  • Design and implement Identity and M&A engagements as a lead in a billable capacity, often presenting as the primary representative of the technical project team.

  • Participate in projects owned by others as an escalation resource in support of fellow team members as needed.

Requirements

Core Technical/Product Skills

Certifications

jobs.excerpt: Mission:Berry Law is a nationally recognized, Veteran-owned law firm committed to delivering the highest-quality veterans disability advocacy in the country.
jobs.description:
Mission:

Berry Law is a nationally recognized, Veteran-owned law firm committed to delivering the highest-quality veterans disability advocacy in the country. We believe that exceptional legal outcomes begin with exceptional legal standards — and that every appeal we file carries the weight of a Veteran's future. The Director of Legal Quality exists to ensure that weight is never taken lightly. If you are a meticulous legal thinker who finds purpose in elevating writing and holding advocacy to an uncompromising standard — this role was built for you. If you believe that great advocacy is built on precision, that every defect is an opportunity to improve, and that Veterans deserve nothing less than the best legal representation available — Berry Law is where you belong.

Role and Reporting Structure

Build and continuously improve Berry Law's legal quality management system to ensure appeals submitted to the VA are legally accurate, factually supported, professionally written, strategically persuasive, and consistently reflect the firm's standards of excellence. The Director of Legal Quality is responsible for reporting defects, identifying systemic quality issues, improving attorney performance through writing skills training, and ensuring Berry Law produces the highest-quality veterans disability advocacy in the country. The Director of Legal Quality reports to the VA Commander and does not have any direct reports.

Qualifications

Required

  • Licensed attorney
  • 5+ years appellate or litigation experience
  • Exceptional legal writing ability
  • Extensive VA appellate experience
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Excellent judgment

Preferred

  • Former appellate clerk
  • Former law review editor
  • Former legal writing professor
  • Experience implementing quality management systems

Responsibilities

Quality Assurance

  • Conduct independent quality reviews of randomly selected appeals
  • Review all appeals from new attorneys for the first 15 days after they graduate from the training platoon.
  • Ensure compliance with Berry Law's Quality Standards.
  • Prevent critical defects before filing.

Quality Improvement

Analyze every defect found during audits. Determine whether the root cause is:

  • knowledge
  • workflow
  • template
  • training
  • AI
  • supervision

Report defect to the VA commander for corrective actions.

Attorney Development

Conduct Quarterly:

  • legal writing workshops
  • appellate advocacy training
  • calibration exercises

Quality Systems

Maintain:

  • QC Standards
  • QC Scorecards
  • Defect Database
  • Writing Guides with Examples
  • Approved Authority Library
  • Template Library
  • AI Prompt Library (FUTURE)
  • Review and report on precedential cases and update the above as necessary

Legal Writing Excellence

Ensure Berry Law writing is:

  • concise
  • accurate
  • persuasive
  • professional
  • easy to read
  • strategically organized

Defect Analysis

Every significant defect receives:

  • root cause
  • corrective action
  • owner
  • deadline to fix (when feasible to fix)
  • a report to VA Commander and assigned Platoon Leader

Quality Analytics

Maintain dashboards showing:

  • defect rates
  • recurring defects
  • attorney trends
  • department trends
  • quality improvement over time

Quality Audits

Conduct weekly audits of:

  • appeals
  • appeal forms

Conduct monthly audits of:

  • templates
  • AI output
  • SOP compliance

Authority

The Director of Legal Quality has authority to:

  • Require Platoon Leader review before filing.
  • Place attorneys on enhanced QC review.
  • Update templates and checklists after consulting with VA Commander.
  • Recommend changes to training.
  • Escalate recurring quality issues to CEO.
  • Recommend attorney and case manager termination directly to the VA Commander.

Quality Control Position Metrics

  • Appeals audited
  • Number / % of audited appeals not meeting quality standards
  • Client legal quality complaints fielded, validated

Awards

Berry Law has been recognized nationally for both its workplace culture and rapid growth, including:

  • 5000: One of America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies (six consecutive years)
  • Law Firm 500: One of the Fastest-Growing Law Firms in the Nation (five consecutive years)
  • Best in Business: Recognized for Veteran Support
  • US. Department of Labor HIRE Vets Medallion Award
  • Secretary of Defense Pro Patria Award
  • Military Times Best for Vets: Employers
  • US. News & World Report Best Companies to Work For

jobs.description:
About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

About The Role

Great products earn three different stories: the one that wins today's market, the one that opens tomorrow's, and the one that proves the architecture underneath both is right.

We're hiring three Product Marketing Managers for our product-facing team, reporting to the Director of Product Marketing (Product). This function owns positioning IP for what we build, while GTM Product Marketing activates it in market. We're growing the team across three focus areas, and we'll match you to the one where your background and interests are the strongest fit.

  • Core Markets. Our established product lines and the verticals that generate the bulk of Fundraise Up's ARR, including existing nonprofit segments and cause and cure organizations.
  • New Products. Capabilities we're extending into where we already have ICP fit but the capability is new to our platform, including peer-to-peer giving and in-person giving.
  • Platform & Core Products. The foundation everything else is built on: our core donation experience (checkout, campaign pages, donor portal, elements, donor documentation), the platform surface beneath it (APIs, integrations, developer experience, payment methods, localization, billing, dashboard, exports), and the experimentation engine that keeps it all improving.

Each track owns its own positioning IP and works the same way day to day, but the buyer, the maturity of the product, and the technical depth required differ. Let us know in your application which focus area is the strongest match for your background; we'll route accordingly during the interview process.

You are expected to be able to take a customer call about your product area without a solutions engineer in the room, at the depth of our public documentation. Our product is complex and deliberately opinionated. Several of our differentiators are architectural, and you'll be expected to explain why the system works the way it does and turn that reasoning into a case customers find compelling. For Platform & Core Products, that extends to holding your own with technical evaluators in RevOps, IT, and data teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run the Early Access Program for your focus area, coordinating with Sales and CS to identify and support customers and design partners on early releases.
  • Be an expert at capturing specific customer requirements from the field that Product Managers can incorporate into the roadmap.
  • Define and continuously evolve product positioning and messaging for your focus area, across relevant personas.
  • Transform complex product capabilities into clear, benefit-driven narratives, and build deep expertise in your product area.
  • Partner closely with Product, and with Engineering or Data Science where relevant, to determine product market fit, TAM, and opportunity cost of decisions.
  • Build and lead launch strategies for your focus area, in partnership with the Director.
  • Deliver content to GTM teams, including Demand Gen and RevOps, to drive awareness, adoption, and revenue impact.
  • Own product-vs-product and roadmap-vs-roadmap competitive intelligence for your focus area.
  • Act as an ambassador for your focus area at conferences, in web content, and in customer-facing material.
  • Contribute to packaging, licensing, and bundling strategy for your focus area.
  • At Fundraise Up, AI is a default tool, not an experimental one. We expect every team member to actively use AI in their day-to-day work, identify where AI can change the shape of problems in their function, and grow their fluency as the tools evolve.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 4+ years in B2B SaaS product marketing, owning end-to-end product positioning and launches.
  • Product depth strong enough to take a customer call in your product area without a solutions engineer in the room.
  • Strong writing and storytelling ability paired with a strategic mind.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally in fast-moving, high-growth environments, and confident leading conversations with Product, Sales, and Executive teams.
  • Solid grasp of marketing funnels, sales cycles, and customer journeys.
  • Deeply curious, data-driven, and motivated by purpose-driven work.
  • Able to travel internationally without restriction. Roughly 25% travel to the US and Europe for conferences, offsites, and industry events; you must be able to obtain the necessary authorizations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in nonprofit tech, fintech, or growth-stage startups.
  • For Core Markets: vertical marketing experience, especially nonprofit, faith, education, or health and cause-area expertise.
  • For New Products: 0 to 1 or new-capability product marketing experience, taking a product from early access through GA with direct early-customer development work, and comfort operating in ambiguity.
  • For Platform & Core Products: technical product marketing experience with platform, API, data, or ML/AI products, and and comfort getting up to speed quickly with a mature, market-leading platform.

You'll Thrive Here If You...

  • You would rather own the source of truth than wait for someone else to write it.
  • You can sit in a customer call and go deep on product with no safety net.
  • You see a stalled launch and start asking why, not whose job it was.
  • You treat AI as a default step in your workflow, not a tool you reach for occasionally.
  • You can turn a messy pile of field requirements into a roadmap-ready brief.
  • You would rather be right about the market than be the loudest voice in the room.
  • You take feedback from Sales, CS, and Product without getting territorial about your positioning.
  • You are comfortable being the one who says a launch is not ready, whether that's a mature product, a brand-new one, or a technical platform release.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is $120,000 - $130,000 USD
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Perks & Benefits

  • Health, Dental, and Vision insurance covered at 100% for employees, 80% for employee plus dependents, and 70% for employees plus family.
  • FSA and HSA Spending Account.
  • 20 days of vacation, 5 sick days, 11 company holidays plus an additional 1 floating holiday.
  • 401(k) plan with company match.
  • 100% Company-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, basic life insurance and AD&D.
  • Paid parental leave (12 weeks for primary caregivers / 6 weeks for secondary caregivers).
  • Generous home office stipend to support your remote workspace.
  • Annual professional development stipend to support your growth (e.g., workshops, courses, and seminars).
  • Charitable giving program and paid volunteer time off with registered non-profits.

***Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.***

True Zero is seeking a Vulnerability Management Lead to oversee enterprise vulnerability management and Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) activities supporting the National Institutes of Health (NIH). This role is responsible for directing the operational vulnerability management program across a diverse enterprise environment while ensuring vulnerabilities are rapidly identified, accurately prioritized, effectively communicated, and successfully remediated.

Working across engineering, incident response, penetration testing, RMF, and ISSO teams, the Vulnerability Management Lead transforms technical vulnerability data into actionable operational priorities. Rather than focusing solely on vulnerability scanning, this position integrates exploit intelligence, attack surface visibility, remediation tracking, and mission impact to help leadership understand where cyber exposure presents the greatest operational risk.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead the enterprise Vulnerability Management and Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) program.
  • Direct vulnerability scanning activities across infrastructure, cloud, endpoints, network devices, and applications.
  • Establish vulnerability prioritization strategies using exploitability, mission impact, Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEVs), threat intelligence, and operational context.
  • Coordinate remediation activities across system owners, engineering teams, and ISSOs to reduce enterprise cyber risk.
  • Monitor remediation progress, validate corrective actions, and ensure vulnerabilities are accurately tracked through POA&M and RMF processes.
  • Lead recurring vulnerability review meetings and communicate remediation priorities to Government stakeholders.
  • Develop executive metrics, dashboards, and reports describing enterprise vulnerability posture, remediation performance, and operational risk trends.
  • Coordinate closely with penetration testing personnel to validate exploitable attack paths and confirm remediation effectiveness.
  • Collaborate with incident response and threat intelligence teams to rapidly reprioritize vulnerabilities based on emerging threats and active exploitation.
  • Support Continuous Monitoring activities by integrating vulnerability data into enterprise cybersecurity reporting and operational decision making.
  • Recommend improvements to vulnerability management processes, automation, workflows, and security tooling.
  • Support Federal cybersecurity reporting requirements and ensure compliance with applicable CISA Binding Operational Directives and NIH vulnerability management guidance.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Five or more years of experience leading enterprise vulnerability management, exposure management, or cybersecurity operations programs.

  • Strong understanding of vulnerability management methodologies, CVSS, Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEVs), threat intelligence, and attack surface management.
  • Experience supporting Federal cybersecurity programs operating under FISMA and the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF).

  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

    • Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.title: Head of AI Safety
jobs.excerpt: Moonshot is recruiting a Head of AI Safety to lead the delivery, development, and growth of our AI Safety portfolio.
jobs.description:
Moonshot is recruiting a Head of AI Safety to lead the delivery, development, and growth of our AI Safety portfolio. The role combines Moonshot's expertise in violence prevention, behavioral risk, and online harms with the emerging practice of evaluating and improving the safety of AI systems. The portfolio addresses harm categories including pathways to violence, extremism, child sexual exploitation, abuse and grooming (CSEA), mental health and crisis, and risks affecting children and teenagers.

The Head of AI Safety will serve as Moonshot's primary applied AI safety counterpart for frontier AI companies, governments, and regulators. The role will work closely with model, policy, trust and safety, product, research, and engineering teams. This is not an engineering or data-science role, but it is a hands-on position requiring the successful candidate to lead and participate directly in red teaming and adversarial evaluation, working in detail with evaluation methodologies, test scenarios, model responses, safety policies, and intervention frameworks. The role holds responsibility for client and partner relationships, project and staff management, methodological quality, and business development. The Head of AI Safety will build and maintain relationships across the wider AI safety ecosystem, including with governments, foundations, regulators, academics, researchers, and civil society organizations.

Candidates must be based in MA, CO, NY, VA, GA, PA, MD, WI, TN, OR, NJ, or DC. Occasional travel may be required.

Your responsibilities will include:

Applied AI Safety, Evaluation, and Advisory

  • Lead and quality-assure Moonshot's applied AI safety work across harm categories including pathways to violence, extremism, CSEA, abuse and grooming, mental health and crisis, and risks affecting children and teens, using methods such as red teaming and adversarial evaluation of AI systems.
  • Advise frontier AI companies on how to improve the safety of their models, products, policies, and intervention systems.
  • Translate insights from psychologists, child-safety specialists, violence-prevention practitioners, safeguarding experts, and other subject-matter experts into clear, actionable guidance for model safety, policy, product, research, and engineering teams.
  • Set the methodological approach for the portfolio, translating violence-prevention, safeguarding, and behavioral-risk expertise into structured and testable evaluation frameworks.
  • Lead and participate directly in red teaming and adversarial evaluation, working in detail with test scenarios, model responses, scoring criteria, safety policies, and evaluation results.
  • Identify patterns, edge cases, and potential safety failures, and develop practical recommendations for improving model behavior and user protections.
  • Maintain rigor and clear documentation across the team's technical deliverables, suitable for technical, government, and foundation audiences.
  • Ensure work is delivered within a clear ethical framework and in compliance with contractual, legal, data protection, and ethics obligations.
  • Identify, manage, and escalate operational, reputational, delivery, and partnership risks.

Client & Partner Management

  • Serve as Moonshot's primary applied AI safety counterpart for frontier AI company partners, governments, regulators, and the wider ecosystem invested in AI safety.
  • Build trusted relationships with model, policy, trust and safety, product, research, and engineering teams.
  • Build and sustain relationships across the wider AI safety ecosystem, including governments, foundations, regulators, academics, researchers, civil society organizations, and specialist practitioners.
  • Represent Moonshot externally in meetings, briefings, workshops, and sector engagement, including with regulators and policymaker audiences.

Team Leadership & Management

  • Provide direct leadership, coaching, and management to Moonshot's AI safety team.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and mission-driven team culture, with particular attention to wellbeing given the sensitive nature of the work.
  • Support workforce planning, performance management, and professional development across the team.
  • Ensure effective coordination with internal teams supporting the portfolio, including operations, finance, research, and technical teams.

Portfolio Development & Growth

  • Develop Moonshot's AI safety portfolio, identifying strategic opportunities, partnerships, and funding.
  • Lead proposal development, scoping, and renewals with technical credibility, using precise, defensible language suited to technical and government audiences.
  • Develop repeatable methodologies, service offerings, and partnerships that allow the portfolio to grow while maintaining methodological rigor and delivery quality.
  • Support external communications, publications, briefings, and thought leadership that establish Moonshot as a credible voice in applied AI safety.
  • Oversee project planning, staffing, budgeting, forecasting, and delivery timelines across the portfolio.

Requirements

Essential:

  • Experience in trust & safety, online harms, or a closely related field such as violence prevention, safeguarding, or public health, and the ability to adapt that knowledge to AI systems.
  • Curiosity about AI and the ability to build technical fluency quickly, enough to engage credibly with technical counterparts at AI companies. Much of this work is new, so comfort learning as you go matters more than existing AI safety expertise.
  • Experience designing research, evaluation frameworks, or interventions for harm categories such as violent extremism, CSEA, self-harm and crisis, or targeted violence.
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects, teams, budgets, partners, and clients, with strong people management skills.
  • Excellent written communication, with experience producing credible (not promotional) material for government, foundation, or enterprise audiences.
  • Comfort and demonstrated resilience working with highly sensitive or graphic content (CSEA, extremist material, crisis content), with awareness of wellbeing practices for this kind of work.
  • Strong judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and sensitive stakeholder environments, including representing organizations externally.
  • Willingness to travel and work outside regular hours where needed to accommodate clients or respond to incidents.
  • Highly trustworthy, with discretion and diplomacy, and willing to undertake relevant security clearance procedures.
  • Experience supporting business development, grant funding, or procurement.
  • Commitment to Moonshot's mission.
  • Candidates must be eligible to work in the US, and will be required to undertake and pass any relevant security clearance procedures per client needs.

Desirable:

  • Direct experience in model safety, red teaming, or adversarial evaluation of LLMs or other AI systems.
  • Understanding of LLM architecture, safety tooling, or trust & safety policy.
  • Prior experience in child safety evaluation, teen-safety product work, or grooming and CSEA detection.
  • Familiarity with government or regulatory engagement, such as briefing officials or supporting policy submissions.
  • Experience with intervention or diversion program design that can transfer to AI-mediated interventions.
  • Academic or applied background in radicalization studies, forensic psychology, or violence risk assessment.
  • Familiarity with taxonomy or classifier development, including how testing data feeds a classifier.

Benefits

  • 15 days paid vacation leave, plus Federal holidays and 1 day additional paid leave for Native American Heritage Day.
  • Flexible public holiday policy with the option to work federal holidays in exchange for a day off at another time.
  • Full private healthcare package, including coverage for partners and children.
  • Dental & Vision Insurance.
  • Life & Disability Insurance.
  • 24/7 access to free counseling via our Employee Assistance Program.
  • 3% matched 401k contributions.
  • 401(k) Roth Contributions.
  • Generous maternity and paternity leave: 26 weeks paid maternity leave, 8 weeks paid paternity leave.
  • All permanent employees are granted share options upon employment.

Salary: $110,000 - $145,000 (depending on skills and experience).

This is a hands-on leadership role. You are as comfortable creating as you are directing. You see opportunities early, define priorities clearly, and help teams turn ideas into real work quickly. You don’t wait for things to happen, you make them happen.

Come be a Funatic

jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

​

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Our mission is to empower data practitioners to create and disseminate organizational knowledge. dbt Core is the open-source engine at the heart of this mission, used by tens of thousands of analysts and engineers to transform data with the rigor of software engineering. We are looking for a systems-oriented engineer to join the small, expert team that builds and maintains this foundational piece of the modern data stack. This is an opportunity to work on deeply technical, high-leverage problems where your contributions will improve the daily workflow of a massive and passionate open-source community.

About The Team

The dbt Core team are the stewards of the open-source engine that powers the modern data stack for tens of thousands of practitioners. This small, high-trust group of systems engineers tackles the most fundamental challenges in dbt: ensuring the performance, reliability, and architectural integrity of dbt itself. They not only own the core execution engine but also architect the crucial adapter framework that connects dbt to a growing ecosystem of databases and data platforms.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Core & Adapters team, you will be a steward of the performance, reliability, and architectural integrity of dbt. You will tackle ambiguous, open-ended problems and take ownership of critical systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Dive deep into the dbt-core execution engine, using your systems expertise to identify, debug, and eliminate performance bottlenecks in our Python codebase.

  • Architect and implement improvements to our adapter interface, the crucial layer that connects dbt to a growing ecosystem of databases and data platforms, enabling the community to build more powerful and efficient integrations.

  • Debug complex, system-level issues that span from Linux process management and concurrency models to database query planning and network protocols.

  • Lead technical design discussions and contribute to the long-term architectural roadmap for dbt Core, making key decisions about what, how, and when we build to ensure its scalability and reliability for years to come.

  • Mentor other engineers and review contributions from our vibrant open-source community, upholding our high standards for code quality, testing, and design while fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment.

  • Take strong ownership of our distributed systems, troubleshoot complex production issues, and participate in an on-call rotation to maintain high availability and deliver a resilient platform experience.

Skills We’re Looking For

We are looking for an engineer with a strong performance and debugging mindset, excellent mental models for complex systems, and a deep curiosity for infrastructure and open-source software.

Required Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on building and operating backend systems in a production environment.
  • Deep backend engineering experience and proficiency in Python.
  • A systematic, first-principles approach to problem-solving, with comfort navigating and debugging in Linux environments (e.g., understanding process scheduling, memory management, file systems).
  • Solid grasp of database internals, such as query execution engines, storage layers, indexing strategies, and transaction management.
  • Excellent communication skills and a sense of ownership, with the ability to balance technical depth with fast, iterative delivery.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A background in data warehousing, data engineering, or analytics engineering.
  • Professional experience writing production code in Go or Rust.
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining a popular open-source project.
  • Experience building compilers, interpreters, or developer tooling.
  • Familiarity with performance analysis tools like perf or strace.

The Team & Our Culture

You will join a small, high-trust team of senior and staff-level engineers who are passionate about building robust, well-crafted, and reliable software. We operate in a remote-first, asynchronous-friendly environment that values deep work, clear written communication, and a high degree of autonomy. We are deeply connected to our users and the open-source community, and we believe that the best solutions come from a rigorous, collaborative, and empathetic engineering process.

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays (including a year end Global Week of Rest), and volunteer days off
