jobs.description:
About the Job:

Feature management and experimentation have converged into a single market, and the buying dynamic at the top has shifted. Engineering teams are no longer the sole evaluator — data scientists and data-focused PMs now carry equal weight on the largest deals. The bar for statistical depth, warehouse ergonomics, and experiment-first workflows is rising quickly.

In traditional experimentation we have built the foundation: a trusted runtime control plane, a growing experimentation engine, and early warehouse-native capabilities. We are winning lower-maturity buyers at healthy rates. We are not yet consistently winning the most sophisticated data organizations. Closing that gap is the job.

In AI experimentation, we have an early lead: the AI-native tooling category has invested in evaluation and conceded production experimentation, and we already have the primitives (statistical significance, multi-armed bandits, experiment-aware guardrails) that no AI-native competitor ships. Extending that lead is the other half of the job.

This leader will own whether LaunchDarkly becomes the definitive experimentation platform in an AI-accelerated world.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the Experimentation pillar. Direct leadership of the Product team. Partner with Engineering and Design counterparts in a triad model. Accountable for the pillar's strategy, roadmap delivery, and commercial outcomes. Make the investment case across the in-product experimentation experience, the warehouse-native analysis layer, and the infrastructure that scales them.
  • Make experimentation the measurement layer of the AI SDLC. Partner with our AI product, observability, and core feature management leaders to productize the capabilities we already have as AI-native primitives. Build a closed loop from offline evaluation through production experiments, to automatic promotion and rollback, to a self-improving feedback loop for agents.
  • Win the high-maturity buyer. Earn the technical confidence of senior data scientists and data-focused PMs. Decide what statistical depth, warehouse coverage, and experiment-first workflow capabilities are non-negotiable, and get them shipped on a timeline that wins pivotal reference deals.
  • Make warehouse-native a weapon. Expand coverage across major data warehouses and query layers. Deliver parity on analysis-only mode, variance reduction, ratio and percentile metrics, exposure validation, and arbitrary-window analysis.
  • Operate a high-performing function. Run a disciplined roadmap, ship predictably against quarterly commitments, drive AI-assisted engineering productivity inside the org, and hire where gaps exist.
  • Be the external face of the category. Credibly represent the product with Data scientists, PMs, experimenters, analysts, and partners. Translate the strategy to the field and equip sales to win head-to-head.

How you'll be measured:

  • Win rate on experimentation-involved deals, especially head-to-head competitive evaluations — step change in the first year, sustained improvement thereafter.
  • Reference-grade customers at the top of the maturity curve, including named strategic logos.
  • Monthly active customers and active-account ARR growth against plan.
  • Experimentation attach rate on new and expansion enterprise deals.
  • Engineering throughput — roadmap delivery velocity and AI-assisted development adoption inside the function.

Qualifications:

  • Senior product leader (GM, VP, or equivalent) with a track record of owning a product line that competes on statistical rigor and data infrastructure.
  • Deep, operator-level fluency in experimentation methodology: causal inference, variance reduction, ratio metrics, sequential testing, exposure design, multi-armed bandits, and composite/multi-objective metrics — and the realities of running these at scale against production data warehouses and against non-deterministic systems where output variance, not just user variance, drives sample-size and significance decisions.
  • Has earned credibility with data science leaders and experimentation specialists at sophisticated organizations — and can recruit them.
  • Has led a function that includes engineering, design, and data science. Comfortable setting a multi-quarter roadmap, championing investment allocation, and reporting results to an executive team and board.
  • Clear, direct communicator. Decides fast with incomplete information. Prefers shipping and learning to requirements documents.
  • Opinionated about where experimentation is going in an AI-native world — and specifically, how agents and autonomous systems will use experimentation infrastructure differently than human teams do.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • You have built or scaled experimentation at an organization where it was core infrastructure, not a secondary analytics capability.
  • You have personally won competitive evaluations where a sophisticated data-science organization was the deciding voice.
  • You have shipped warehouse-native data products and understand the operational realities of running experiments directly against customer data infrastructure.
  • You see experimentation as how software teams prove that any change — whether built by a person or an AI agent — actually worked. That evidence layer is core infrastructure, not a reporting afterthought.

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $301,000 - $414,000**

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Our Product Marketing team’s mission is to generate customer insights that inform Stripe’s product strategy, and lead go-to-market for our suite of products. Product Marketing is a highly cross-functional role at Stripe, partnering closely with Product and Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, Demand Generation and Campaigns to name a few. Different from many other Product Marketing teams, our team works across the entire product lifecycle, from helping shape the product, to driving launch and commercialization, to growing product adoption post-launch.

We’re looking to hire a Consumer Product Marketing Lead to own go-to-market strategy and positioning for Link as we scale the world's most widely used digital wallet. Link is Stripe’s digital wallet, already used by 250+ million consumers, with millions more joining the network every month. This role sits at the center of Stripe's consumer ambitions—translating Link's product innovations into compelling narratives that drive discovery, adoption, and loyalty at scale.

What you’ll do

As Consumer Product Marketing Lead for Link, you will own strategy and execution across positioning and go-to-market to grow Link's network—and bring the next hundreds of millions of shoppers into the network.

  • Define Link's consumer positioning and messaging: Develop and continuously evolve Link's core value proposition and messaging framework for consumers, ensuring a consistent and compelling story across every touchpoint.
  • Lead go-to-market for product launches: Own the end-to-end GTM strategy for new Link features and consumer experiences, from early product shaping through launch execution and post-launch measurement.
  • Shape the product roadmap: Be the voice of the consumer in product planning. Synthesize qualitative insights, quantitative research, and competitive intelligence to influence feature prioritization and roadmap strategy.
  • Partner with Brand Marketing: Work in lockstep with the Brand Marketing team to ensure brand campaigns are grounded in product truths and that high-impact brand moments connect back to measurable product outcomes.
  • Drive consumer research and insights: Commission and synthesize user research, behavioral analytics, and market data to develop a deep understanding of Link's target personas, adoption barriers, and engagement drivers.
  • Define and track consumer growth metrics: Set KPIs across the consumer marketing funnel (awareness, activation, engagement, retention), own regular reporting, and use data to continuously optimize the marketing mix.
  • Influence senior leadership: Communicate product strategy, consumer insights, and marketing results clearly and persuasively to Stripe leadership and cross-functional partners.

Who you are

  • An expert in consumer product marketing: You have a strong track record building go-to-market strategies for high-scale B2C products, ideally in fintech, payments, or consumer tech. You know how to earn consumer trust and translate product complexity into clear, irresistible value.
  • A sharp strategist and structured thinker: You can synthesize research, competitive signals, and product data into a compelling point of view, and you're confident presenting that perspective to senior leadership.
  • Highly cross-functional: You're a natural collaborator who holds your own in product discussions, aligns with brand and creative teams, and influences without authority across a matrixed organization.
  • Data-driven and measurement-minded: You define success in metrics, know how to attribute marketing activities to consumer outcomes, and use data to continuously improve your approach.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: You thrive in fast-moving, zero-to-one environments and are energized by the challenge of building new capabilities at scale.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in product marketing, with 5+ years in B2C products
  • Proven track record developing consumer positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy for scaled consumer products
  • Strong research and analytical skills; ability to synthesize consumer insights, market data, and competitive intelligence into actionable strategy
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to and influencing senior stakeholders
  • Demonstrated success working cross-functionally across product, brand, creative, and analytics teams

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

IT Intern – Business Systems & Automation

Bickert Management Inc. (BMI)
Location:Remote
Schedule:Full-time, 40 hours per week, aligned with BMI’s Alberta business day (Mountain Time)
Internship arrangement:Paid or unpaid, depending on the candidate, location, applicable requirements, and the final terms agreed before the internship begins

Build real technical capability through real work

Bickert Management Inc. (BMI) is seeking an intelligent, resourceful, and highly coachable IT Intern who wants to develop practical skills in business systems, software customization, workflow automation, and technical problem-solving.

BMI helps organizations improve how they operate by designing, implementing, customizing, and supporting business systems. Much of our work is performed within the Zoho ecosystem and may include application configuration, data structure, workflow design, business process automation, integrations, reporting, troubleshooting, Deluge scripting, and other forms of technical customization.

This is not an internship built around passive observation or academic exercises. The intern will learn in context: first through structured onboarding, guided study, shadowing, and light assignments, and then through increasingly meaningful internal and client work as capability is demonstrated.

The objective is to help a high-potential person develop into a well-rounded BMI technician. The pace of that progression will depend heavily on the intern’s aptitude, initiative, reliability, and ability to convert instruction into productive execution.

What matters most to us

We are more interested in raw capability and character than in conventional credentials.

Formal education, certifications, and years of experience can be useful, but they are not reliable substitutes for intelligence, honesty, resourcefulness, work ethic, sound judgment, and the ability to learn quickly. BMI takes pride in identifying undervalued talent: capable people whose potential may not yet be fully reflected in their résumé, credentials, or previous opportunities.

The strongest candidates will demonstrate:

  • High intellectual aptitude and strong abstract-reasoning ability

  • Resourcefulness when instructions are incomplete or a solution is not immediately obvious

  • Analytical thinking and disciplined problem-solving

  • Honesty, reliability, and personal accountability

  • A strong work ethic and consistent follow-through

  • Coachability and the ability to apply feedback quickly

  • Curiosity and a genuine interest in technology and business systems

  • Adaptability in a software industry that changes rapidly

  • The judgment to ask good questions without becoming dependent on constant direction

  • Careful attention to detail while still understanding the larger objective

What the internship will involve

Early assignments will be selected according to the intern’s current skill level. A new learner may begin with structured training, observation, documentation, testing, data work, simple configurations, and low-risk internal tasks. A candidate who arrives with stronger technical or Zoho experience may progress more quickly into substantive assignments.

Over time, the work may include:

  • Learning the Zoho ecosystem and BMI’s approach to business-systems implementation

  • Shadowing experienced technicians and Client Success Partners

  • Configuring and customizing Zoho applications

  • Supporting data preparation, migration, validation, and cleanup

  • Building and testing workflows, alerts, approvals, and automations

  • Mapping business requirements into practical system behavior

  • Troubleshooting technical and process-related problems

  • Producing clear technical documentation and internal notes

  • Assisting with reports, dashboards, integrations, and quality assurance

  • Learning Deluge scripting and other technical tools used in BMI implementations

  • Completing increasingly complex internal and client assignments as readiness is demonstrated

The balance between learning and execution will change over time. Successful interns are those who steadily require less basic instruction, demonstrate sound judgment, and earn the opportunity to take on more advanced work.

Zoho experience

Previous Zoho experience is not required. BMI is prepared to train a person with the right underlying qualities from the ground up.

However, meaningful experience with Zoho—particularly hands-on experience configuring applications, building automations, working with data, or writing Deluge—will be considered a significant competitive advantage. It may allow a successful candidate to begin at a more advanced level and progress more quickly.

Experience with other CRM, low-code, database, automation, scripting, or business-software platforms is also valuable when it demonstrates transferable reasoning and technical aptitude.

Communication and language

Strong working English is required because the intern must understand instructions, document work clearly, collaborate with BMI team members, and communicate accurately about technical issues.

This is primarily a technical development role, not a client-relationship position. A polished presentation style or accent-free spoken English is not required. The ability to participate effectively in client meetings is an asset and may create additional opportunities, but technical capability, clear internal communication, and dependable execution are more important.

Working hours and remote environment

This is a full-time remote internship requiring 40 hours per week during BMI’s Alberta business day, aligned with Mountain Time and our Calgary head office.

BMI may grant greater scheduling autonomy after a team member has demonstrated reliability and earned that flexibility. Applicants should nevertheless assume that the initial internship will involve defined working hours, active supervision, regular communication, clear priorities, and accountability for assigned work.

Candidates must provide:

  • A dependable computer suitable for professional technical work

  • A stable, high-speed internet connection (>300 Mbps)

  • A quiet and professional remote workspace

  • Reliable availability during the required Mountain Time schedule

  • The ability to participate in video meetings, screen sharing, and remote collaboration

BMI will provide access to the internal systems, learning resources, guidance, and software accounts required for assigned work.

Education and experience

No particular degree, field of study, certification, or minimum number of years of experience is required.

Applicants may include students, recent graduates, self-taught technologists, career changers, or people whose professional history does not yet reflect their full potential. We welcome evidence of ability from personal projects, practical exercises, volunteer work, freelance work, previous employment, or independent learning.

What matters is whether the candidate can demonstrate the aptitude, character, and learning velocity required to become highly effective.

Potential longer-term opportunities

This internship is intended to develop practical capability, but it does not guarantee employment or contract work afterward.

Depending on performance, organizational requirements, and mutual fit, a successful intern may later be considered for hourly employment with BMI or opportunities as a Service Partner. Any future arrangement would be discussed separately and would depend on demonstrated performance and the needs of the business.

About BMI

Bickert Management Inc. is a Canadian executive consulting and business-systems firm headquartered in Calgary, Alberta, with a distributed remote team. We help clients translate business objectives into better processes, better information, and better technology-enabled execution.

Our environment rewards continuous improvement, thoughtful experimentation, accountability, and the ability to adapt. We work in a fast-changing industry and expect team members to keep learning as platforms, tools, and client needs evolve.

How to apply

Please submit a résumé and a brief explanation of why you believe you have the aptitude and personal qualities to succeed in this internship.

Candidates are encouraged to describe examples of:

  • Something technically difficult they taught themselves

  • A situation in which they solved a problem without having complete instructions

  • A project or responsibility that demonstrates reliability and follow-through

  • Any experience with Zoho, CRM systems, databases, workflow automation, scripting, low-code platforms, or related tools

Applicants should be prepared to complete practical assessments designed to evaluate reasoning, learning ability, problem-solving, attention to detail, and technical potential. Selection will not be based solely on résumé credentials or interview presentation.

BMI is committed to evaluating candidates according to their demonstrated capabilities and the requirements of the role.


Requirements

Technical Requirements:

  • Reliable desktop or laptop computer

  • High-speed internet

  • Webcam

  • Noise-canceling headset/speakers/microphone

  • Quiet, tidy, dedicated workspace

Personal Requirements:
  • Motivated
  • hard-working
  • willing to learn

jobs.excerpt: The Supplier Auditor applies knowledge, technical skills, and expertise to effectively conduct vendor food safety audits to ensure the quality and food safety of Mom’s Meals.
jobs.description:
The Supplier Auditor applies knowledge, technical skills, and expertise to effectively conduct vendor food safety audits to ensure the quality and food safety of Mom’s Meals. This position is responsible for managing the audit program which includes performance of onsite vendor assessments, identification of risks, and timely closure to documented findings. This position works closely with Purchasing personnel to manage vendors within the supply chain. This position reports directly to the VP of Technical Services.
Salary Range: $79,386-109,155 plus 15% annual bonus
Remote hires will be required to travel to our headquarters in Ankeny, IA (company paid) on their first day for orientation.
At this time, we are NOT considering applicants that require immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) now or in the future to work in the United States. This includes, but IS NOT LIMITED TO: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J-1, etc.
Benefits
Our employees enjoy a generous package of benefits that we are thrilled to provide, and feel is part of what makes us different as an employer. We value our team members, and this is one way we can show it.
Benefits include:
-PTO, holiday pay and holiday of choice
-401(k) match
-Life insurance
-Short-term disability79,386-
-Health, dental and vision insurance
-Maternity/paternity leave
-Health savings account (HSA)
-Flex spending accounts (FSA) – health and dependent

Position Responsibilities may include, but not limited to

  • Schedule and conduct onsite vendor food safety and quality assessments through collaboration with Internal Stakeholders for new potential vendors
  • Maintain current supplier approval schedule and conduct re-evaluation audits per the defined frequency
  • Thoroughly assess vendor risks as it relates to various product types (i.e., Meat, poultry, egg, dairy, baked goods, fruit/vegetables, food additives/ingredients, etc.) and applicable regulations (i.e. USDA and FDA) and Quality Standards (i.e. SQF, BRC, etc.)
  • Write reports and communicate findings in a timely manner to execute prompt closure to identified nonconformances
  • Follow up with suppliers on corrective action plans as needed to ensure the appropriate level of action is taken to eliminate nonconformance
  • Work with suppliers to improve their overall service level, including compliance to specifications and COA requirements
  • Identify, measure, implement and report on continuous improvement initiatives within the supply chain program (i.e. Supplier Performance metrics, etc.)
  • Further develop and evolve food safety and quality risk assessment criteria and supplier qualification programs, assist with HACCP and Food Safety Plans as needed
  • Assist in analyzing complaint data as it relates to raw materials to identify trends and opportunities with vendors to drive continuous improvement
  • Assure programs, policies and procedures are compliant and kept current
  • Input supplier data within the computerized quality management system to ensure current information is maintained

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Meat Science or similar science degree
  • 5+ years’ experience in a quality assurance role in a food manufacturing facility
  • Strong technical expertise in auditing skills
  • Prior experience auditing food companies
  • Knowledge of food safety mitigation processing techniques to reduce microbial, chemical, and foreign material hazards
  • Familiarity with various industries such as Dairy, Meat and Poultry, Egg, Seafood, Food Additives
  • Excellent knowledge of HACCP & HARPC and experience in implementation of Food Safety Management Plans
  • Certification by a recognized HACCP training provider (Meat, Poultry)
  • Working knowledge of regulations and guidelines such as FDA and USDA titles 21 and 9 for GMPs and quality programs
  • Ability to work autonomously to conduct audits as needed
  • Ability to communicate persuasively and passionately about the need for food safety & quality
  • Proficient use of Microsoft Office programs
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong initiative and ability to work as part of a team; communicate effectively
  • Excellent organization, time management and decision-making skills
  • Excellent verbal and written skills
  • Ability to travel up to 75%

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Prior work experience as an auditor within FSSC 22000, SQF or BRC audit schemes or experience working in a certified facility
  • Previous experience as a lead auditor or ASQ Certified Auditor

Physical Requirements

  • Repetitive motions that include the wrists, hands and/or fingers
  • Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting, remaining in a stationary position for prolonged periods
  • Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

Company Overview

Mom’s Meals is a home-delivered meal service providing fully prepared, refrigerated meal solutions direct to homes nationwide since 1999. We provide seniors, patients recovering post-discharge and those managing a chronic condition with tailored nutrition solutions to manage their specific needs. If you are passionate about the well-being of others and have a strong sense of community, Mom’s Meals could be the place for you! We are a family operated business looking for fun, compassionate, and friendly people who want to make a difference in the lives of others.

EEO

jobs.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

We are hiring for a Senior Manager, Retention and Lifecycle. Grüns is a subscription business, which means the relationship we build with every customer is one of our biggest levers on lifetime value. This role owns that relationship end to end: the right message, at the right time, in the right channel, for every customer. You'll take our lifecycle program from manual campaign production to an always-on, AI-driven testing engine, and you'll do it hands on keyboard, not from a distance.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Own 1:1 personalization across every one-to-one channel we use today (email, SMS, direct mail) and the ones we're testing next
  • Run end-to-end ownership of automated lifecycle flows across welcome, post-purchase, billing reminders, cancel/winback, one-time-purchase to subscription conversion, and cross-sell
  • Shift the program from manual builds and one-off sends to an always-on system that tests and optimizes itself
  • Build out our email and SMS list growth engine beyond standard on-site capture
  • Evaluate and implement the tools that let us enrich and act on customer data, then turn that data into real decisions on message, channel, and timing
  • Lead an offshore production team on design, build, and QA, with the goal of running an increasingly automated system rather than managing manual output

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 5-8+ years in-house owning lifecycle, retention, or CRM at a consumer subscription brand
  • Has owned both automated flows and one-off campaigns across email and SMS, end to end
  • Has run a structured testing roadmap with real holdouts and reported actual incremental impact, not just open rates
  • Has hands-on experience implementing personalization or data enrichment tools, not just briefing someone else on them
  • Uses AI as a core part of how they build, test, send, and report
  • Bonus: has worked somewhere with both a subscription and retail presence

Approach to the role:

  • AI-first. Constantly asking what should never be done manually again
  • Thinks about subscribers as relationships, not a list
  • Every idea becomes a real test with a real read
  • Owns the program end to end. Comfortable in ambiguity, doesn't need to be told what's next
  • High craft, high speed, and a strong partner to ecomm, paid, CX, and data

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is $130,000-$160,000 plus bonus depending on experience, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Synera is the AI Agent Platform for Engineering — a platform where digital coworkers execute real engineering work inside CAD, CAE, and PLM costing tools, turning days of complex engineering processes into minutes. Our clients include BMW, Airbus, and NASA, and we're growing fast.

You'll be joining Kacey and the Marketing team as Synera's first dedicated bottom-of-the-funnel product marketer — the person who bridges the gap between deep product knowledge and market-facing communication. Engineering buyers leaders need to understand what Synera does, how it works inside their actual tool stack, and why now is the moment to adopt agentic AI. And engineers need to see real use cases on the challenges they face every day, and learn how easy Synera is to use.

You'll build the content, the narratives, and the reusable assets that make this possible across every channel and touchpoint.

You'll own product messaging end-to-end and work closely with Product Managers, the Chief Product Officer, Sales, Customer Success, technical SMEs, the Partner Marketing team, and channel owners across website, webinars, LinkedIn, YouTube, and events.

👉 What a week at Synera could look like:

  • Monday: Join the all-hands, then sync with Kacey and the CPO to align on the latest product capability updates coming out of the R&D teams for the next product release.

  • Tuesday: Interview a technical SME about a new simulation use case before heading to your Claude projects to turn your notes into a messaging doc for the feature release. The campaign agent you built prompts you about the audience and goals before it uses the messaging to kick off the campaign workflow.

  • Wednesday: Review a competitive analysis, interview the sales team to incorporate their feedback in a battlecard, and review the images for a competitive comparison blog post. End your day with a content team sync on the customer success stories in the pipeline.

  • Thursday: Run a content planning session with the Customer Success team — aligning on what assets are needed for their expansion campaigns and check-in on the number of demo requests from product landing pages and portal sign-ups, so you can weave optimizations into your next sprint plan.

  • Friday: Wrap up a demo video script and log into Synera to build the demo — then close out the week with a quick async check-in with our CSM Rob on US team in Boston.

⚡ In 6 months:

  • You're a Synera super user

  • A clear product marketing content engine is established with reusable assets across video, one-pagers, product web pages, slides, and blogs

  • Sales and marketing channel owners have stronger, consistently used product narratives that are adapted to target personas, key use cases, and industries

  • Competitive comparisons for select competitors are live

  • First signals from CS or Sales that materials are positively impacting opportunity conversion

  • A steady increase in demo requests is coming in from the first multi-channel campaign that you launched

⚡ In 12 months:

  • Your campaigns are producing predictable pipeline

  • All our customers know you and you have a clear vision for how each of their successes will help achieve our marketing objectives

  • Product messaging is consistent across website, webinars, ads, sales, social, partner, and influencer content

  • Re-engagement campaigns for lost deals are live and first deals re-opened

  • Product marketing content operates as a repeatable function, supported by AI-first workflows and documented SOPs

Here is our team at the summer event - join us at the next one! 👋

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary ranges are:

We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

  • Prefer two wheels over four? 🚲 We’ve got you covered with JobRad.

Requirements

🚀 WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As the President of Industries, you will lead and oversee Toptal’s Industries function, working closely with our Heads of Industries, and industry-related GMs for each vertical. The Industries team is responsible for go-to-market (GTM) strategy per industry, as well as for being the key driver of revenue for all service lines at Toptal. You will be responsible for driving strategic growth across verticals, ensuring alignment, scalability, and performance throughout the Industries function. This role is central to Toptal’s continued market leadership and growth, requiring a blend of strategic vision, operational excellence, and hands-on leadership. You will need to drive revenue and sales, this will be the absolutely most important part of your job. You will do this through working with our hunters to hunt and our farmers to build prosperous farms. Knowing who should be a hunter. vs. farmer and how to drive each is key. Knowing how to align the team with the relevant service lines is also key.

A huge portion of your role will be constructing, managing, and scaling a world-class accounts management process. This is the most important capability for driving revenue and sales within our company and it will be at least 50% of your focus. This will be coupled with ensuring that your Industry function is doing exceptional consulting and solutioning with all clients, all of the time. Threading the needle here with the service lines will be key to running a successful accounts management process.

You will collaborate closely with the Executive team to define priorities, unlock new market opportunities, and build trusted relationships with leaders at our top strategic clients.

This is a remote position, though you will be expected to meet with your team monthly to drive sales and strategy. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Partner closely with the team of GMs responsible for Toptal’s key industry verticals.
  • Align and manage the industry verticals with the service verticals to ensure strategy and delivery are fully aligned with the Industry function.
  • Oversee and unify the GTM functions across Enterprise, ensuring all teams are operating with consistency, clarity and alignment to both vertical and company-wide growth initiatives.
  • Build and maintain direct relationships with senior executives at key clients, supporting high-impact pursuits and strategic account growth.
  • Drive revenue growth across verticals by identifying cross-industry opportunities, harmonizing sales practices, and aligning the team on best-in-class client delivery.
  • Set sales standards and work with GMs and sales leaders on how to build and scale high-performing GTM teams across multiple client segments.
  • Own quarterly planning for Industries, including revenue targets, headcount strategy, sales role allocation, and account segmentation.
  • Partner with cross-functional leadership to ensure integrated support and alignment across GTM and operational initiatives.
  • Lead performance visibility and forecasting across all teams, tracking pipeline health, conversion rates, client satisfaction, and productivity at every level.
  • Lead operational reviews with GMs and GTM teams to assess deal progress, pipeline velocity, and client growth strategies.
  • Support GMs and frontline managers in hiring, onboarding, coaching, and developing talent.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to GTM leaders and team members on pipeline management, feedback, and performance development when needed.
  • Partner closely with a team of high-level and consultative practitioners within each industry who drive sales via consulting and solutioning, that blows the minds of clients and makes those clients want to work with us based on the quality of our consulting and solutions delivered to them.
  • Support the hiring and development of a team of hunters and farmers per Industry vertical. Know how to identify and hire for each.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Learn Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
  • Meet key stakeholders and begin relationship building with the leadership teams.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Assess the health and maturity of each vertical and GTM function.
  • Review and calibrate existing GTM plans, vertical strategies, and performance data across teams.
  • Begin regular alignment cadences with GMs and sales leadership to review key metrics and expectations.
  • Establish a strategic plan to drive cross-vertical collaboration and capability sharing.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Operationalize a scalable framework for GM and GTM performance visibility and business reporting.
  • Help GMs and GTM teams close key deals and open new enterprise doors, leveraging your industry relationships.
  • Implement mechanisms to drive alignment, share best practices, and accelerate new logo acquisition and account expansion across industries and other areas.
  • Partner with Leadership to support the hiring of multiple Industry GMs and ensure their teams are structured optimally to drive and scale revenue.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Lead the execution of established revenue targets across all verticals, ensuring teams are consistently closing high-value, multi-phase enterprise deals.
  • Support GMs and GTM leaders in advancing late-stage opportunities and securing wins with top-tier enterprise clients.
  • Identify and remove bottlenecks in the sales cycle to improve velocity, conversion rates, and average deal size across verticals.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure proposals, pricing, legal, and delivery processes are tightly aligned and optimized for enterprise-scale engagements.
  • Continue to refine and scale repeatable deal execution practices across verticals, sharing best practices and success patterns across teams.
  • Ensure each vertical is consistently expanding client footprint through upsells, cross-sells, and renewal strategies in active accounts.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Partner with Leadership to ensure the full team of GMs are in place.
  • Foster a high-performing, collaborative Industries and GTM leadership ecosystem that consistently exceeds revenue goals.
  • Deliver results that surpass annual revenue targets across all industry verticals through sustained new logo acquisition and strategic account growth.
  • Partner with the Executive Team to shape and execute the next phase of go-to-market strategy, including potential expansion into new verticals or solution areas.
  • Institutionalize long-term strategic account planning across verticals to improve client retention, lifetime value, and revenue predictability.
  • Serve as a visible leader within Toptal, setting the standard for execution, accountability, and client-centricity.
  • Establish Toptal as the enterprise partner of choice across verticals backed by a world-class GTM organization and deep industry leadership.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • 15+ years of enterprise B2B leadership experience, including 10+ years in executive roles with full P&L ownership across multiple verticals and sales organizations.
  • Proven track record managing large, complex portfolios and driving substantial revenue growth and profitability.
  • Demonstrated success scaling multi-industry go-to-market teams with direct oversight of complex commercial operations.
  • Management consulting experience at a top-tier firm (e.g., McKinsey, Bain, BCG) or investment banking experience is preferred but not required.
  • Experience leading large, distributed sales teams within high-growth technology or professional services environments.
  • Deep expertise in enterprise sales methodology and leading consultative, multi-phase sales pursuits.
  • Proven ability to manage extensive client portfolios and accelerate revenue growth across multiple verticals.
  • Excellent organization skills and detail-oriented. You are hyper-organized, know how to work efficiently, and prioritize execution, as well as mentor others to do the same.
  • Exceptional communicator and storyteller with executive presence.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate across functions including Sales, Marketing, Finance, Delivery, and Product.
  • Strong track record of coaching and developing sales leaders and team members across all levels.
  • Willingness to travel to meet with clients, team members, and stakeholders.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Essential Job Functions

  • Regularly and reliably attend scheduled virtual team meetings on camera.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Use all required digital collaboration tools.
  • Prioritize and self-manage workflows and deadlines.

US FLSA Classification: Full-Time/Exempt

For candidates who meet the qualifications and job requirements listed above, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. In the US, Toptal’s benefit offerings include participation in a 401(k) retirement plan; medical, dental, and vision health insurance plans; basic life insurance coverage and short-term and long-term disability coverage; access to flexible spending, dependent care, and health savings accounts; access to telehealth virtual doctors; an employee assistance program; and flexible paid time off.

About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Research Scientist
jobs.excerpt: Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.
jobs.description:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

Reporting to Omada's Senior Director, Clinical & Translational Research, the Senior Clinical Research Scientist is part of the Clinical & Translational Research team. This role is responsible for conceptualizing research questions and study designs; analyzing and interpreting data from multiple sources, including internal member-level data, external EHR data, healthcare claims, survey data, and clinical trial databases; and communicating results through peer-reviewed manuscripts, abstracts, white papers, value dossiers, and other internal and external reports.

This role will also serve as a key scientific partner in generating clinical, economic, and health outcomes evidence that demonstrates the value of Omada's programs to members, customers, and other external stakeholders. In addition to core clinical and translational research responsibilities, this role will have a strong focus on health economics and outcomes research (HEOR), including cost-effectiveness, budget impact, utilization, and return on investment analyses to support product strategy, customer value propositions, and commercial growth.

Your impact:

  • Design and conduct studies and analyses to generate high-quality evidence for Omada's programs by writing detailed evaluation plans and statistical analysis plans, performing advanced statistical analyses, and interpreting and summarizing results.
  • Design studies that incorporate mixed methods, integrating quantitative and qualitative data to assess clinical outcomes, member experience, engagement, and implementation effectiveness.
  • Lead or support HEOR analyses, including cost-effectiveness, cost-offset, budget impact, utilization, and return on investment studies across Omada's lines of business and condition areas.
  • Develop evidence packages that connect clinical outcomes to economic value for health plans, employers, health systems, and other strategic customers.
  • Analyze medical and pharmacy claims, EHR, laboratory, biometric, and program engagement data to quantify impact on utilization, total cost of care, quality measures, and member outcomes.
  • Partner with Clinical Strategy, Commercial, Product, Finance, and Market Access teams to translate research findings into compelling customer-facing stories, value narratives, and commercialization assets, establishing recurring cross‑functional forums and decision touchpoints where HEOR insights inform strategy and influence diverse internal and external stakeholders.
  • Disseminate findings through peer-reviewed manuscripts, abstracts, conference presentations, white papers, dossiers, and commercial evidence materials.
  • Serve as a representative for the Clinical & Translational Research team in cross-functional settings, demonstrating strong scientific judgment and the ability to align evidence generation with organizational priorities.
  • Support the broader research program by clearly communicating how study findings advance Omada's strategic goals, scientific leadership, and market differentiation.
  • Contribute to studies that assess the clinical effectiveness, real-world effectiveness, and economic value of digital health behavior change programs for chronic conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, obesity, and musculoskeletal conditions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional program squads to design experiments and quality improvement initiatives that improve engagement, clinical outcomes, healthcare utilization, and value realization using evidence-based behavioral science approaches.
  • Help shape Omada's HEOR roadmap by identifying priority evidence gaps, study opportunities, and publication strategies that strengthen external credibility and commercial readiness, leading department‑level HEOR and evidence‑generation initiatives in partnership with the Senior Director and cross‑functional leaders.
  • Build a culture of transparency and scientific rigor within the Clinical & Translational Research team by clearly communicating HEOR objectives, evidence priorities, and study findings, and regularly connecting the team’s work to Omada’s mission and strategic goals.

About you:

You are passionate about understanding the clinical and economic impact of digital health behavior change programs on preventing and treating chronic disease and improving healthcare delivery. You bring strong scientific rigor, analytic depth, and a clear understanding of how outcomes evidence supports customer adoption, payer credibility, and business growth.

To be successful, you will need:

  • 10+ years relevant experience with a PhD, DrPH, PharmD, MD, ScD, or equivalent advanced training in health economics, epidemiology, biostatistics, health services research, outcomes research, psychology, public health, data science, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and executing HEOR, real-world evidence, or health services research studies.
  • Strong subject matter expertise in claims data, health plan quality measures, chronic disease, health behavior, AI fluency and agency and/or healthcare delivery transformation.
  • Experience with statistical and analytic software such as SAS, STATA, SQL, R, Python, or equivalent tools.
  • Strong SQL skills and the ability to work with large, complex healthcare datasets end to end, from extraction and cleaning through analysis, interpretation, and communication.
  • 3+ years of healthcare analytics experience, including experience with medical and pharmacy claims, EHR data, and other real-world data sources.
  • Experience evaluating healthcare utilization, total cost of care, quality performance, and economic outcomes.
  • Familiarity with common HEOR methods such as causal inference, comparative effectiveness research, propensity score methods, difference-in-differences, cost analyses, budget impact modeling, and cost-effectiveness analysis.
  • Ability to synthesize complex findings into clear, decision-oriented insights for scientific, clinical, and commercial audiences.

To stand out:

  • Digital health industry experience
  • Experience with Tableau and/or similar BI tool
  • Experience working on chronic disease research (e.g., diabetes, hypertension, MSK)
  • Passionate about improving health behaviors and reducing the incidence, prevalence, and severity of chronic diseases
  • Experience in digital health, virtual care, or chronic condition management.
  • Experience building economic models, value frameworks, payer-facing evidence decks, or other market access materials.
  • Experience working on cardiometabolic or chronic disease research, including diabetes, obesity, hypertension, or musculoskeletal conditions.
  • Experience publishing HEOR or real-world evidence studies in peer-reviewed journals or presenting at relevant scientific meetings.
  • Experience using Tableau or similar BI tools to communicate outcomes and economic insights.
  • Familiarity with employer, health plan, Medicare Advantage, and risk-based care use cases for digital health evidence.
  • Passion for improving health behaviors and reducing the incidence, prevalence, severity, and cost burden of chronic disease.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. The Veterans Disability Case Manager is responsible for developing and preparing written work product in support of veterans' disability claims and appeals. Working under attorney-directed case strategy, this role reviews medical records, military service records, VA decisions, and supporting evidence to develop persuasive written arguments and supporting documentation. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys spending most of their day reading, analyzing, researching, and writing. We believe high performers should be rewarded. This role offers opportunities for performance-based incentives tied to productivity, quality, and contribution to case outcomes. Why This Role Matters

Every document you prepare helps build a stronger case for a veteran seeking benefits they earned through service.

Your work directly supports the legal strategy developed by attorneys and contributes to outcomes that can significantly improve the lives of veterans and their families. If you love writing, enjoy analytical work, and want your efforts to make a meaningful difference, this role was built for you.

Working independently within established policies, procedures, and approval thresholds, you will exercise sound judgment in managing assigned opportunities, prioritizing work, resolving routine issues, and advancing engagements through the sales and contracting process with limited day-to-day direction from management.

Key Responsibilities

1- Manage Sales Opportunities, Engagement Scoping, Staffing, and Pricing Activities:

  • Independently manage assigned business development opportunities from qualification through contract execution, serving as the primary client contact through execution.

  • Partner with Sales Leads and client servicing teams to define engagement scope, deliverables, staffing requirements, resource assumptions, and implementation approach for new, renewal, and expanded consulting engagements.

  • Develop proposals, statements of work, pricing models, and other sales materials to support client acquisition and account growth.

  • Evaluate proposed pricing structures to ensure alignment with the firm's financial performance, profitability, utilization, and revenue objectives.

  • Coordinate internal approvals related to proposals, pricing, staffing, contracts, and conflict-of-interest reviews.

  • Monitor opportunity progression, resolve routine operational matters, and proactively drive next steps to support the timely execution of client contracts.

  • Ensure compliance with established sales, contracting, pricing, and approval requirements throughout the sales lifecycle.

2- Support Client-Facing Business Development Activities:

  • Participate in prospective client meetings, discovery sessions, and sales discussions.

  • Coordinate meeting materials and follow-up actions.

  • Serve as a liaison between prospective clients, Sales Leads, and internal stakeholders throughout the sales and contracting process.

  • Assist with responding to client inquiries and requests during pursuit, proposal, and negotiation activities.

3-Administer Contracting and Negotiation Activities:

  • Support contract negotiations by coordinating reviews of contractual terms and documenting requested modifications.

  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Sales Leads, and operational leadership to facilitate contract review and issue resolution.

  • Ensure required approvals, executed agreements, and supporting documentation are completed and maintained in accordance with firm requirements.

  • Coordinate the transition of executed engagements to client service teams.

4- Maintain Sales Pipeline Data, Reporting, and Forecasting Information:

  • Maintain accurate opportunity information within CRM and sales pipeline systems.

  • Monitor data quality and communicate risks or delays that may impact sales performance or opportunity progression.

5- Support Strategic Growth Operations Initiatives and Continuous Improvement:

  • Participate in special projects and operational initiatives that improve sales, contracting, and business development effectiveness.

  • Contribute to the development of tools, templates, knowledge management resources, and process improvements.

  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, standardization, and scalability across the sales and contracting function.

  • Coordinate with Marketing to support execution of go-to-market plans for the business line.

Key Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Marketing, Communications, or related field preferred.

  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience in sales operations, business development support, contract administration, project management, consulting operations, client services, or a related professional services environment.

  • Experience supporting sales pursuits and managing opportunities through proposal development, pricing, contract negotiation, and contract execution processes required.

  • Experience developing staffing plans, resource models, pricing analyses, budgets, or financial models in support of consulting, professional services, or project-based engagements preferred.

  • Experience coordinating multiple concurrent projects, proposals, or business development activities while meeting established deadlines required.

  • Experience working collaboratively with cross-functional teams, including sales, operations, finance, legal, and client service stakeholders required.

  • Experience supporting new business development efforts, account expansion initiatives, and client relationship management activities preferred.

  • Familiarity with contractual documents, including non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), business associate agreements (BAAs), professional services agreements, master services agreements, statements of work (SOWs), and related contract terms.

  • Experience within healthcare, managed care, Medicaid, public sector consulting, or professional services organizations strongly preferred.

Critical Professional Related Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of sales operations, business development processes, contracting workflows, pricing methodologies, and approval governance.

  • Ability to develop and analyze pricing models, resource plans, staffing assumptions, and financial projections.

  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar) and pipeline management processes.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling, data analysis, and reporting.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint, and Teams.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and business judgment skills.

  • Ability to interpret contractual language and identify operational, financial, and compliance considerations.

  • Strong project coordination and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.

Other Requirements

  • Ability to operate independently within established policies, procedures, pricing guidelines, and approval thresholds while exercising sound judgment and discretion.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines with limited day-to-day supervision.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex business, operational, and financial concepts to diverse audiences.

  • Ability to effectively participate in prospective client meetings and interact professionally with clients, executives, and internal stakeholders.

Compensation & Benefits

jobs.title: Demand Generation Manager
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreAkkadian Labs is a Collaboration Lifecycle Automation Platform that services some of the largest global enterprises and government agencies.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Akkadian Labs is a Collaboration Lifecycle Automation Platform that services some of the largest global enterprises and government agencies. Our platform currently reduces manual work by up to 90% and costs by as much as 50%, while improving accuracy and governance across leading Unified Communications platforms.

This ability to innovate at scale defines who we are: big enough to compete at the highest level, yet agile enough to stay ahead of a rapidly evolving market. Our culture is people-first, fully remote, and rooted in grit, clarity, trust and respect, because when our people thrive, so do our customers.

Who You Are

You thrive in complex B2B environments, driving demand through Account-Based Marketing - direct enterprise channels and, through partner ecosystems including authorized resellers, service providers, and integration partners. You understand how to build scalable partner-led programs, co-marketing motions, and joint pipeline engines that create predictable demand.

You bring rigor to how pipeline gets built, working backward from the ARR target to determine how much qualified pipeline needs to be in motion at any given time, and you hold yourself accountable to that math. You dig into account and funnel data regularly, not just to report on it, but to catch where deals are stalling and bring sales clear, specific recommendations on what to do next. You care as much about clean, standardized data (HubSpot lifecycle stages, attribution, partner association) as you do about the campaigns themselves, because you know unreliable data undermines every decision built on top of it. Equal parts analyst and operator, you turn every dollar of spend into measurable pipeline, revenue, and customer impact.

Core Responsibilities

  • Marketing & Campaign Management
    • Build, manage, and continuously refine orchestrated, account-based and partner-based campaign sequencing, integrated end-to-end (email, LinkedIn, partner, events, sales follow-up), that proves out the account-based, partner-led model and establishes a repeatable template for future campaigns.
    • Lead multi-channel demand generation marketing (SEM, paid social, programmatic, retargeting, affiliates) to drive leads, pipeline, and revenue.
  • Ensure we are focused on the right accounts, and the right people in them.
    • Maintain and update ICP inclusion/exclusion criteria; continuously rescore and prioritize Tier 1–3 accounts to concentrate high-touch effort on a manageable, well-defined set.
    • Maintain and continually update buying committee maps across target accounts (economic, technical, operational, security, procurement, and champion roles), ensuring key contacts across those roles are identified and actively engaged for all Tier 1–2 accounts.
    • Own the account-level funnel (ICP → Target → Engaged → MQA → SAA → Qualified Opportunity → Pipeline → Closed-Won) as the core measurement framework for demand generation performance.
    • Continuously analyze account and funnel data to identify where accounts are stalling or losing momentum, and proactively bring findings and recommended next actions to sales to keep opportunities moving.
  • Activate partners as a primary route to market, not a channel.
    • Establish partner prioritization criteria based on ICP alignment, account access, and willingness to execute; maintain a ranked view of highest-value partners.
    • Maintain and continually update the mapping of priority partners to target accounts, determining, account by account, whether activity is Akkadian-led, partner-led, or joint.
    • Track and report partner-sourced versus partner-influenced pipeline as a standing metric, distinct from general partner activity.
    • Develop and execute partner-led demand generation programs with authorized resellers and integration partners, including co-marketing campaigns, MDF utilization, webinars, and joint events.
    • Build scalable partner enablement and activation workflows, including partner-specific messaging, playbooks, landing pages, nurture streams, and analytics dashboards to measure partner pipeline contribution.
  • Backsolve pipeline from the ARR target and make it measurable.
    • Standardize HubSpot data structure and attribution, including lifecycle stage, source, persona, tier, and partner association, distinguishing sourced from influenced contribution; collaborate with Sales on UTM hygiene and offline conversion tracking.
    • Run the weekly, monthly, and quarterly operating cadence that reports progress against the account-level funnel and pipeline targets.
  • Leadership Responsibilities
    • Supervise the Marketing Coordinator, setting clear goals and regularly measuring progress against them.
    • Provide ongoing feedback and coaching and conduct formal performance reviews on Akkadian's standard cadence.
    • Support the Marketing Coordinator's development by identifying growth opportunities and building toward increased ownership over time.

Supporting Responsibilities

    • Develop messaging and assets that resonate with our ICP, using generative AI to accelerate ideas while safeguarding brand voice.
    • Partner with leadership to review and reallocate budget for maximum ROI.
    • Apply the latest tools to accelerate content, forecasting, segmentation, and spend optimization.
    • Stay ahead of industry trends and explore AI-powered tools to keep our marketing stack efficient, insightful, and growth-focused.
    • Optimize the website for SEO, UX, and conversion.
    • Lead high-impact field and virtual events (e.g., Cisco Live, enterprise UC user groups), ensuring clear playbooks and ROI analysis.
    • Meet KPIs including CAC, payback, pipeline coverage, lead-to-SQL conversion, and MQL velocity, delivering marketing insights weekly to leadership.

Requirements

Our Ideal Candidate has the following qualifications:

  • 5+ years in B2B SaaS marketing with significant experience generating pipeline through partner-led go-to-market, including resellers, service providers, or system integrators.
  • Demonstrated track record building partner co-marketing programs that produce measurable sourced or influenced revenue.
  • Proven success scaling revenue and pipeline with clear KPI ownership.
  • Experience building and maintaining ICP and account-tiering frameworks to focus go-to-market effort on the highest-value accounts.
  • Experience running ABM, paid search/social, and lifecycle email programs, integrating intent data, predictive scoring, and AI-driven content.
  • Familiarity with buying-committee mapping methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC) to identify and engage economic, technical, operational, security, procurement, and champion roles within target accounts.
  • HubSpot fluency, including lifecycle stage tracking, attribution, and campaign management.
  • Experience partnering directly with sales on funnel-stage and deal-level analysis, not just campaign reporting, to help identify stalled opportunities and recommend next steps.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered marketing tools including prompt libraries, AI-generated ad tests, predictive scoring, and forecasting.
  • Fluency in growth metrics (CAC, LTV, NRR, ACV) and strong modeling skills.
  • Strong storyteller and copywriter able to translate technical value into compelling campaigns.
  • Certifications welcome: Google Analytics IQ, HubSpot Reporting, HubSpot Inbound/RevOps, 6sense Practitioner, Prompt Engineering.
  • Bachelor’s degree appreciated, but proven performance, demand generation expertise, and adaptability matter most.

Benefits

We offer a fully remote environment, plus a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, company-paid life insurance and disability policies, 401(k) with a generous matching program, and paid time off.

jobs.description:
ServiceNow is seeking a Brand Strategist to support strategic brand development and positioning within the Brand Strategy team. This role will help shape how ServiceNow is positioned, understood, and differentiated in the market—developing the audience insights, frameworks and competitive positioning that inform brand and marketing work and the connection points between brand and integrated marketing campaigns.

This role is for someone who is curious about enterprise transformation in the age of AI and who can translate immense market and audience complexity into clear positioning and strategic recommendations. You’ll support the brand strategy team in audience and market research and act as a strategic partner to integrated marketing, mapping audience and messaging strategies from brand to buying groups. You’ll help us reinforce the role of brand through well-articulated points-of-view, grounded in industry research and emerging brand effectiveness thinking.

You'll partner across brand, product marketing, integrated marketing, and with internal and external research partners to build strategies grounded in market research, buyer insights, and landscape analysis. Along the way, you'll help us explore how AI can accelerate research, competitive analysis, and strategy while deepening the insight-driven thinking that shapes our brand direction.

What you'll do

  • Develop and stress-test brand positioning, architecture, and competitive strategy across ServiceNow's portfolio and business functions, informed by primary research, market data, and competitive analysis.

  • Conduct audience research and buyer insight analysis across key personas and buying groups—including IT, HR, Customer Service, and Security & Risk—to understand their priorities, decision-making criteria, and how ServiceNow is perceived.

  • Build strategic frameworks that guide brand decisions: brand architecture models, category definitions, competitive positioning maps, and persona-based strategy documents.

  • Support brand measurement and health tracking— interpreting brand trackers, correlating findings with other sources and translating metrics into strategic recommendations for leadership.

  • Competitive intelligence analysis, including positioning research, messaging analysis, and landscape mapping that informs our strategic differentiation.

  • Support M&A integration and acquisition strategy through brand architecture assessment, equity evaluation, and integration recommendations.

  • Use primary research (surveys, interviews, focus groups), secondary sources (analyst reports, market data), and campaign performance data to validate and evolve strategy.

  • Experiment with AI tools that accelerate research synthesis, competitive analysis, and strategic modeling, sharing findings and best practices with the team.

  • Support the existing team with ongoing programs and initiatives

What you'll bring

  • Several years of experience in brand strategy, communications planning, or insights development—at an agency, consultancy, or in-house marketing function. B2B enterprise experience preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience developing brand positioning, architecture strategies, or competitive positioning frameworks grounded in research and market analysis.

  • Strong capability in audience research and insight development—designing research, analyzing findings, and translating insights into strategic recommendations.

  • Solid understanding of brand measurement, tracker design, and how to interpret brand health metrics to inform strategy.

  • Ability to synthesize complex market, competitive, and customer data into clear strategic recommendations for leadership.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills—you can distill complex analysis into compelling strategy documents and present recommendations with confidence to senior leaders.

  • Comfort designing and interpreting primary research (surveys, interviews) and working with research methodologies.

  • Intellectual curiosity about competitive landscapes, market trends, and category dynamics—you read widely and think strategically about how markets shift.

  • Curiosity about AI and enthusiasm for using new tools to enhance research, analysis, and strategic thinking.

  • An eagerness to develop expertise, contribute to cross-functional strategic discussions, and raise the bar on brand strategy rigor.

  • A self-starter mentality, proactively spotting opportunities and taking steps to surface and solve them

We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.
